          <div>
            <a id="Cybersecurity"><!--Anchor--></a>
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="text-align: right; vertical-align: top; width: 45pt;">
                    <div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: bold; color: #000000;">Item 16K.</span></div>
                  </td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                    <div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Cybersecurity</span></div>
                  </td>

  </tr>


</table>
          </div>

          <div>&#160;</div>

          <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">We regularly assess risks from cybersecurity threats, monitor our information systems for potential vulnerabilities and tests those systems pursuant to our cybersecurity, policies, standards,
            processes and practices. To protect our information systems from cybersecurity threats, we use various security tools that help us to identify, escalate, investigate, resolve and recover from security incidents in a timely manner. These efforts
            include, among other things: mandatory trainings and drills on phishing attacks for all our employees and penetration testing, to help us evaluate the effectiveness of our information security processes and improve our security measures and
            planning.</div>

          <div>&#160;</div>

          <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">Our cybersecurity program includes an incident response plan to engage cross-functionally across our company and report cybersecurity incidents to appropriate levels of management, including
            senior management, and the Audit Committee or Board of Directors, based on potential impact. We conduct annual cybersecurity awareness training and routinely tests cybersecurity awareness In addition, we engage third-party cybersecurity experts
            to test, evaluate and recommend improvements on the effectiveness of our cybersecurity program through penetration testing, breach assessments, regular cybersecurity incident drill testing.</div>

          <div>&#160;</div>

          <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">
            <div style="text-align: left; color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We base our cybersecurity on the Cybersecurity Framework developed by U.S. Department of Commerce&#8217;s National Institute Standards and Technology
              (&#8220;NIST&#8221;). We assess the maturity level tested against the latest cybersecurity trends and disclosure research. Our framework is based on NIST&#8217;s core functions to help us identify cybersecurity compliance gaps and requirements.</div>

          </div>

          <div>
<div>&#160;
            </div>
<div style="text-align: left; color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">Governance</div>

            <div><br/>
            </div>

            <div style="text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 18pt;">Our Chief Information Security Officer (&#8220;CISO&#8221;), in coordination with &#8220;Planning and risk management&#8221;, is responsible for
              leading the assessment and management of cybersecurity risks. The current CISO has over 20 years of experience in information security. The CISO provides regular reports to our senior management throughout the year, and to the Audit Committee
              or the Board of Directors, as appropriate. Such reports typically address, among other things, the our cybersecurity strategy, initiatives, key security metrics, penetration testing and benchmarking learnings, and business response plans as
              well as the evolving cybersecurity threat landscape. As of the date of this Annual Report, we have not identified any risks from known cybersecurity threats, including as a result of any prior cybersecurity incidents, that have materially
              affected, or are reasonably likely to materially affect us, including our business strategy, results of operations, or financial condition. While we believe our cybersecurity program to be appropriate for managing constantly evolving
              cybersecurity risks, no program can fully protect against all possible adverse events. </div>

            <div style="text-align: left; color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
            </div>

            <div style="text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 18pt;">Our audit department, through an independent consultant, conducts a cybersecurity assessment and preparedness.</div>

            <div style="text-align: left; color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
            </div>

            <div style="text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 18pt;">Annually and on an as-necessary basis, members of management and/or of the risk committee provide presentations to the Audit
              Committee regarding cybersecurity matters, including any material risks. These presentations include information regarding cybersecurity risks, the evolution of those risks and initiatives to optimize and improve the processes of
              cybersecurity.</div>

            <div style="text-align: left; color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
            </div>

            <div style="text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 18pt;">We take a risk-based approach to cybersecurity and have implemented cybersecurity policies throughout our operations that
              are designed to address cybersecurity threats and incidents. In particular, in the event of a specific cybersecurity incident, a damage assessment report is prepared including information about the relevant security incident, such as incident
              status, informed stakeholders and remediation plans.</div>

            <div style="text-align: left; color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
            </div>

            <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">For additional information on these risks and potential consequences if the measures we are taking prove to be insufficient or if our proprietary data is otherwise not protected, see &#8220;Item 3. Key Information. D.
              Risk Factors: Our business has become dependent on digital technologies to conduct day-to-day operations and we may be subject to cyberattacks or other risks related to new technologies.&#8221;<br/>
            </div>

          </div>

          <div>&#160;</div>

          <div class="BRPFPageBreakArea" style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;">
            <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">207</span></div>

            <div class="BRPFPageBreak" style="page-break-after: always;">
              <hr style="margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; border-width: 0; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; clear: both;"/></div>

            <div class="BRPFPageHeader" style="width: 100%;">
              <div>
                <div style="font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: italic;">
                  <div style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: normal;"><a href="#TABLEOFCONTENTS">Table
                      of Contents</a></div>

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">Annually and on an as-necessary basis, members of management and/or of the risk committee provide presentations to the Audit Committee regarding cybersecurity matters, including any material
            risks. These presentations include information regarding cybersecurity risks, the evolution of those risks and initiatives to optimize and improve the processes of cybersecurity.</div>

          <div>&#160;</div>

          <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">We take a risk-based approach to cybersecurity and have implemented cybersecurity policies throughout our operations that are designed to address cybersecurity threats and incidents. In
            particular, in the event of a specific cybersecurity incident, these presentations include information about the relevant security incident, such as incident status, informed stakeholders and remediation plans.</div>

          <div>&#160;</div>

          <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">Our Chief Information Security Officer (&#8220;CISO&#8221;), in coordination with &#8220;Planning and risk management&#8221;, is responsible for leading the assessment and management of cybersecurity risks. The
            current CISO has over 20 years of experience in information security. The CISO provides regular reports to the Corporation&#8217;s senior management throughout the year, and to the Audit Committee or the Board of Directors, as appropriate, in its
            annual cybersecurity review. Such reports typically address, among other things, the Corporation&#8217;s cybersecurity strategy, initiatives, key security metrics, penetration testing and benchmarking learnings, and business response plans as well as
            the evolving cybersecurity threat landscape. As of the date of this Annual Report, we have not identified any risks from known cybersecurity threats, including as a result of any prior cybersecurity incidents, that have materially affected, or
            are reasonably likely to materially affect us, including our business strategy, results of operations, or financial condition. While we believe our cybersecurity program to be appropriate for managing constantly evolving cybersecurity risks, no
            program can fully protect against all possible adverse events. For additional information on these risks and potential consequences if the measures we are taking prove to be insufficient or if our proprietary data is otherwise not protected,
            see &#8220;Item 3. Key Information. D. Risk Factors: Our business has become dependent on digital technologies to conduct day-to-day operations and we may be subject to cyberattacks or other risks related to new technologies.&#8221;</div>

    <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">REPORT OF INDEPENDENT REGISTERED PUBLIC ACCOUNTING FIRMS</div>

    <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">
<div><br/></div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">To the Board of Directors and Shareholders of</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Opinion on the Consolidated Financial Statements</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We have audited the accompanying consolidated
          statements of financial position of Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. and its subsidiaries (together the &#8220;Company&#8221;) as of December 31, 2023 and 2022, the related consolidated statements of comprehensive income, changes in equity and cash flows
          for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2023,&#160;</span>and the related notes (collectively referred to as the &#8220;consolidated<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>financial statements&#8221;).&#160; In our opinion, the consolidated
        financial statements&#160;<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position</span>&#160;of the Company<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;as of December 31, 2023 and 2022, and the results of its operations
          and its cash flows for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2023, in conformity with&#160;</span>International Financial Reporting Standards as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">.</span></div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">We also have audited, in accordance with the standards of the Public Company
        Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (&#8220;PCAOB&#8221;), the Company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2023, based on criteria established in the Internal Control&#8211;Integrated Framework issued by the Committee of Sponsoring
        Organizations of the Treadway Commission (2013 framework) and our report dated April 24, 2024 expressed an unqualified opinion thereon.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Basis for Opinion</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">These consolidated financial statements are the responsibility of the Company&#8217;s
        management.&#160; Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements based on our audits.&#160; We are public accounting firms registered with the PCAOB and are required to be independent with respect to the
        Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">We conducted our audits of these consolidated financial statements in accordance
        with the standards of the PCAOB.&#160; Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the consolidated financial statements are free of material misstatement, whether due to error or fraud. Our
        audits included performing procedures to assess the risks of material misstatement of the consolidated financial statements, whether due to error or fraud, and performing procedures that respond to those risks.&#160; Such procedures included examining,
        on a test basis, evidence regarding the amounts and disclosures in the consolidated financial statements.&#160; Our audits also included evaluating the accounting principles used and significant estimates made by management, as well as evaluating the
        overall presentation of the consolidated financial statements.&#160; We believe that our audits provide a reasonable basis for our opinion.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Critical Audit Matter</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">The critical audit matter communicated below is a matter arising from the current
        period audit of the consolidated financial statements that was communicated or required to be communicated to the audit committee and that: (i) relates to accounts or disclosures that are material to the consolidated financial statements and (ii)
        involved our especially challenging, subjective, or complex judgments. The communication of the critical audit matter does not alter in any way our opinion on the consolidated financial statements, taken as a whole, and we are not, by communicating
        the critical audit matter below, providing a separate opinion on the critical audit matter or on the accounts or disclosures to which it relates.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div class="BRPFPageNumberArea" style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">F-1</span></div>

      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
        <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;"/></div>

      <div class="BRPFPageHeader" style="width: 100%;">
        <div>
          <div style="font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: italic;">
            <div style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: normal;"><a href="#TABLEOFCONTENTS">Table of
                Contents</a></div>

    <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">
      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; margin-right: 3.5pt; margin-left: 0.65pt; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Impairment of long-lived assets&#160;<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">related to Property, Plant &amp; Equipment of the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating unit</span></div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify; font-style: italic;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Description of the matter</span></div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">At December 31, 2023, the Company&#8217;s net book value of Property, Plant &amp;
        Equipment (&#8220;PPE&#8221;) related to the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating unit was Argentine Pesos 571,161 million. As discussed in Notes 4 (j) and 5 (a) to the consolidated financial statements, PPE is tested to assess whether an impairment or
        reversal of a previous impairment is required when significant changes took place during the period, or that will take place in the near future, indicate that the recoverable value of the PPE amounts may be affected. An asset&#8217;s recoverable amount
        is the higher of the fair value less costs to sell that asset, and its value-in-use. The value in use is calculated based on discounted future cash flows. Management&#8217;s projected cash flows for the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating unit
        considered significant judgements and assumptions relating to: discount rate, estimates of future tariff and the recognition of cost adjustments, and expected macroeconomic variables such as inflation and foreign exchange rates.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">The principal considerations for our determination that performing procedures
        relating to the impairment of long-lived assets for PPE of the Natural Gas Transportation cash-generating unit is a critical audit matter are the significant judgment by management in estimating the value in use of this cash-generating unit, a high
        degree of auditor judgment, subjectivity and effort in performing procedures and evaluating management&#8217;s&#160; significant assumptions related to discount rate, estimates of future tariff and the recognition of cost adjustments and expected
        macroeconomic variables such as inflation and foreign exchange rates. In addition, the audit effort involved professionals with specialized skill and knowledge.</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; margin-left: 0.65pt; font-style: italic;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">How we addressed the matter in our audit</span></div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
      </div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; margin-left: 0.65pt;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Addressing the matter
          involved performing procedures and evaluating audit evidence in connection with forming our overall opinion on the consolidated financial statements. These audit procedures included obtaining an understanding, evaluating the design and testing
          the operating effectiveness of controls over management&#8217;s impairment review process, including controls over the review of the significant assumptions.&#160;</span>These procedures also&#160;<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">included, among others,
          evaluating the estimation methodology and testing the aforementioned significant assumptions and the completeness, accuracy, and relevance of underlying data used. The significant assumptions were compared with available economic trend data; the
          historical accuracy of management&#8217;s estimates was evaluated; sensitivity analyses of the significant assumptions were performed to evaluate the changes in the value in use that would result from changes in the assumptions; the arithmetical
          accuracy of the discounted cash flows model was evaluated; and the disclosures in the consolidated financial statements were assessed. Professionals with specialized skill and knowledge were involved to assist in the evaluation of the methodology
          and the significant assumptions used in the future cash flows estimated by management.</span></div>

    </div>

      <div style="text-align: left; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>

      <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">To the Board of Directors and Shareholders of</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A.</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Opinion on Internal Control over Financial Reporting</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We have audited Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A.
        and its subsidiaries (together the &#8220;Company&#8221;)</span>&#160;internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2023, based on criteria established in&#160;<span style="font-style: italic;">Internal Control&#160; Integrated Framework</span><span style="color: rgb(255, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (2013 framework) (&#8220;the COSO criteria&#8221;). In our opinion, the Company maintained, in all material respects, effective internal
      control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2023, based on the COSO criteria.</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">We also have audited, in accordance with the standards of the Public Company
      Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (&#8220;PCAOB&#8221;), the consolidated statements of financial position of the Company as of December 31, 2023 and 2022, and the related consolidated statements of comprehensive income, changes in equity and cash flows
      for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2023, and the related notes (collectively referred to as the &#8220;consolidated financial statements&#8221;), and our report dated April 24, 2024 expressed an unqualified opinion thereon.</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Basis for Opinion</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">
      <div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
        <div style="text-align: left; color: #000000; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
          <div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
            <div style="text-align: left; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company's management is responsible for maintaining effective internal control over financial reporting, and for its assessment of the effectiveness of internal
              control over financial reporting included in the accompanying Management&#8217;s Annual Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting.&#160; Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting
              based on our audit.&#160; We are public accounting firms registered with the PCAOB and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the
              Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.</div>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We conducted our</span>&#160;audit i<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">n accordance with the standards of the PCAOB.&#160; Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether effective internal control over financial reporting was maintained in all material
        respects.</span></div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">Our audit included obtaining an understanding of internal control over financial
      reporting, assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal control based on the assessed risk, and performing such other procedures as we considered necessary in the
      circumstances. We believe that our audit provides a reasonable basis for our opinion.</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;">Definition and Limitations of Internal Control over Financial Reporting</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">A company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to provide
      reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. A company&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting
      includes those policies and procedures that (i) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the transactions and dispositions of the assets of the company; (ii) provide reasonable assurance that
      transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, and that receipts and expenditures of the company are being made only in accordance with authorizations
      of management and directors of the company; and (iii) provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the company&#8217;s assets that could have a material effect on the financial
      statements.</div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"><br/>
    </div>

    <div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting may not
      prevent or detect misstatements. Also, projections of any evaluation of effectiveness to future periods are subject to the risk that controls may become inadequate because of changes in conditions, or that the degree of compliance with the policies
      or procedures may deteriorate.</div>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be4452" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be4453">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Business Overview</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be4453" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be4454">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be4454" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be4455">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (&#8220;<span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) is one of the companies created as a result of the privatization of
      Gas del Estado S.E. (&#8220;GdE&#8221;). tgs commenced operations on December 28, 1992 and it is mainly engaged in the Transportation of Natural Gas, and Production and Commercialization of natural gas Liquids (&#8220;Liquids&#8221;). tgs&#8217;s pipeline system connects major
      natural gas fields in southern and western Argentina with natural gas distributors and industries in those areas and in the greater Buenos Aires area. The natural gas transportation license to operate this system was exclusively granted to <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>for a period of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfTransportationLicenseGranted" id="Fact_ea35aac0a0564d3094005cf71030362c" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">thirty-five years</ix:nonNumeric> (&#8220;the License&#8221;). <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>is






      entitled to a <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:NumberOfExtensionOnLicenseGranted" id="Fact_cf05367671cf4b8a91ea4ab4742e3ec5" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U005" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">one</ix:nonFraction>-time extension of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfExtensionOnLicenseGranted" id="Fact_ffa5c416d09f43abaecca6a1aa42536a" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric> provided that it has essentially met the obligations imposed by the License and by the <span style="font-style: italic;">Ente Nacional Regulador del Gas</span> (National Gas Regulatory Body or &#8220;ENARGAS&#8221;). The General Cerri
      Gas Processing Complex (the &#8220;Cerri Complex&#8221;), where <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>processes natural gas by extracting liquids, was transferred from GdE along with the gas transmission assets. <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>also





      provides midstream services, which mainly consist of gas treatment, removal of impurities from the natural gas stream, gas compression, <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">gas transportation in fields,</span> </span>wellhead gas gathering and pipeline construction, operation and maintenance services. Also, telecommunications services are provided
      through the subsidiary Telcosur S.A. (&#8220;Telcosur&#8221;). These services consist of data transmission services through a network of digital terrestrial radio relay.</div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic; text-align: justify;">General framework</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44525" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44526">

<div>
      The Company operates in a complex economic context whose main variables have recently had strong volatility as a result of political and economic events at the national level.</div>
</ix:continuation></div>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44527" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44528">
<div><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"><br/>
    </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
    <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44528" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44529">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">2023 was a year in which the Argentine economy went through high levels of volatility and uncertainty. On the one hand, at the beginning of the year there was a record
        drought that implied a drop of approximately US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:LiquidationOfForeignCurrencyByAgroExportSector" id="Fact_7049765fe2b1455cad6c9164577b0afa" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U006" decimals="-6" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">20,000</ix:nonFraction> million in the liquidation of foreign currency by the agro-export sector,
        negatively impacting not only the accounts of the Argentine Central Bank (&#8220;BCRA&#8221;) but also in tax collection. Additionally, as in any election year, political uncertainty has also generated deep macroeconomic imbalances.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44529" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44530">
<div><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44530" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44531">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">This situation led the administration of former President Alberto Fern&#225;ndez to adopt various measures including, among others: (i) the issuance of new exchange
        restrictions, (ii) the establishment of the Tax for an Inclusive and Solidarity Argentina (&#8220;PAIS&#8221; according to its initials in Spanish), applicable to the acquisitions by Argentine residents of foreign currency intended for the purchase of certain
        goods and services from abroad, and other taxes in order to reduce the fiscal deficit and (iii) the freezing of certain internal prices.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44531" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44532">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

    <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44533" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44534">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The low level of reserves in the BCRA has led the national government to restrict access to the Free and Single Exchange Market (&#8220;MULC&#8221; according to its initials in
        Spanish) in order to contain the demand for dollars and the flight of foreign currency, which means for the company a restriction when operating their businesses. These restrictions involved the implementation of an import payment control system
        subject to a series of limits determined by the Ministry of Commerce and the Federal Administration of Public Revenues (&#8220;AFIP&#8221; according to its initials in Spanish).</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44534" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44535">
<div><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44535" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44536">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On October 22, 2023, the general elections were held in Argentina. The result yielded a new conformation of Congress as of December 10, 2023 (in a minority for the
        president-elect). On November 19, 2023, the runoff election was held, in which the opposition candidate for La Libertad Avanza politic party, Javier Milei, was elected president.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44536" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44537">
<div><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44537" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44538">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">After taking office, the current administration launched a package of emergency measures aimed at relaxing controls and deregulating the economy, with the main
        objective of reducing the fiscal deficit. Among the main measures adopted we can mention:</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44538" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44539">
<div><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44539" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44540">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span><span style="width: 9pt; font-size: 1px; display: inline-block;" class="HorizontalTab"> &#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Announcement of an economic plan centered on the review of fiscal, exchange and monetary policy in which, among other issues: (i) a sharp cut in public spending is shown along with an increase in certain taxes, (ii) the price of the
          US dollar was raised against the Argentine peso from $/US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ClosingForeignExchangeRate" id="Fact_05e5d844c44b4fcf9df185278f0c9bf4" contextRef="c20231209" unitRef="U007" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">350</ix:nonFraction> to $/US$ <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ClosingForeignExchangeRate" id="Fact_58ca39035c614b379710cfe8448384b7" contextRef="c20231210" unitRef="U007" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">800</ix:nonFraction> and a monthly devaluation of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfMonthlyDevaluationPesoAgainstUSDollars" id="Fact_2a6d477a7346403dafb73613ba509308" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">2</ix:nonFraction>%, (iii) reduction of energy and
          transportation subsidies and (iv) limits the monetary issue and modifies the Treasury financing program in order to reduce the BCRA&#8217;s liabilities.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44540" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44541">
<div><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44541" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44542">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span><span style="width: 9pt; font-size: 1px; display: inline-block;" class="HorizontalTab"> &#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Issuance of the Decree of Necessity and Urgency (DNU) No. 70/2023 - &#8220;Bases for the Reconstruction of the Argentine Economy&#8221; that declares the public emergency in economic, financial, fiscal, administrative, pension, tariff, health
          and social matters until on December 31, 2025. This decree promotes economic deregulation and the insertion of Argentina in world trade through the adoption of international standards for the trade of goods and services.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44542" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44543">

<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span><span style="width: 9pt; font-size: 1px; display: inline-block;" class="HorizontalTab"> &#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">On December 27, 2023, the National Executive Branch sent the Draft Law of Bases and Starting Points for the Freedom of Argentines (the &#8220;Omnibus Law&#8221;) for consideration by the National Congress. On February 6, 2024, the government was
          forced to return the Omnibus Law to committees, since they did not gather the number of votes necessary for its approval. As of the date of issuance of these Consolidated Financial Statements, it is not possible to predict the impact that the
          Omnibus Law may have on our financial situation, equity and results of operations.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44544" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44545">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">Restrictions on the Free and Single Exchange Market (&#8220;MULC&#8221;)</div>
</ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44557" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44558">

</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: italic;">BCRA regulations</div>
</ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44559" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44560">
<div><br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44560" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44561">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The low level of reserves in the BCRA has led the national government to maintain very restrictive exchange controls for the purchase of foreign currency in the MULC
          for much of the year.</div>
</ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44561" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44562">

        </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In order to regulate access to the MULC in order to contain the demand for dollars, the BCRA established a series of requirements that require the request for prior
          authorization from the BCRA for certain transactions, among them are the following:</div>
</ix:continuation>

        </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span><span style="width: 9pt; font-size: 1px; display: inline-block;" class="HorizontalTab"> &#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Payment of dividends to non-residents;</span></div>
</ix:continuation>

        </div>

</ix:continuation>

        </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">All of these measures have been intensifying since April 2020, including measures linked to the trading of stock assets by companies.</div>
</ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44573" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44574">

        </div>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44574" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44575">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Effective as of December 13, 2023, the BCRA issued Communication &#8220;A&#8221; 7917 in which a series of modifications are established for the purposes of access to the MULC.
          Between them:</div>
</ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44575" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44576">

        </div>

</ix:continuation>

        </div>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44578" continuedAt="Text_a5f6874f4c7b46be879e0cc0539be44579">
<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span><span style="width: 9pt; font-size: 1px; display: inline-block;" class="HorizontalTab"> &#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">For new debts for imports, access to the MULC may be granted, without the need for prior approval from the BCRA, to make deferred payments for new imports of goods with customs entry registration according to the schedule
            established by type of goods.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>

The purpose of this bond is to pay off
            the importers&#8217; debts, for which they had to previously register in a registry enabled for such purpose at the AFIP.</span></div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Law No. 27,541 on Social Solidarity and Productive Reactivation in the Framework of the Public Emergency (B.O. 12/23/2019) and its modifications created the
          so-called PAIS Tax, which established a tax applicable to acquisitions by Argentine residents of currency foreign currency intended for the purchase of certain goods and services from abroad.</div>
</ix:continuation>

          following operations:</div>

        Tax is provided for in the case of acquisition of goods from the <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfTaxToBePaidForAcquisitionOfGoodsOfFinalPayment" id="Fact_6cef1647b27c4cc983c99d4ec70e9725" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">95</ix:nonFraction>% of the total final tax to be paid. Said payment on account must be

The balance for the remaining <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfTaxToBePaidAtTheTimeOfAccessingMULCForAcquisitionOfGoodsOfFinalPayment" id="Fact_4b6d325715de42bc972f01cd7d5da551" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">5</ix:nonFraction>% PAIS tax must be paid

        Program created by Decree No. 576/22. by the Society.</div>

        of the value of its exports in foreign currency into the country.         negotiable securities. To qualify for the scheme, exports must be settled between October 2 and October 20, 2023, and the effective export date must not be later than November 30, 2023.</div>
</ix:continuation>

The remaining <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInPesos" id="Fact_34a82bbd4558495689572deb8dec5fba" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">20</ix:nonFraction>% may be settled in pesos through the purchase of negotiable securities, the validity of the rule not being specified.</div>

    <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
      <ix:continuation id="Text_5375cb1aa3a146beb0672d250a4356ee4" continuedAt="Text_5375cb1aa3a146beb0672d250a4356ee5">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 8pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The CNV, in Title IV, Chapter III, Article 1 of the Rules has provided that listed companies must submit their consolidated financial statements by
        applying Technical Resolution No. 26 of the Argentine Federation of Professional Councils of Economic Sciences (&#8220;FACPCE&#8221;), which adopts the IFRS Accounting Standards issued by the IASB, its amendments and circulars for the adoption of IFRS
        Accounting Standards that the FACPCE dictates in accordance with the provisions of that Technical Resolution.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    </div>

    <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%15%F-%%-->
    <ix:continuation id="Text_5375cb1aa3a146beb0672d250a4356ee5" continuedAt="Text_5375cb1aa3a146beb0672d250a4356ee6">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The preparation of the consolidated financial statements in conformity with IFRS Accounting Standards requires management to make accounting estimates and assumptions
      that affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities and the disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the consolidated financial statements, as well as the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the reporting
      fiscal year. Estimates are used when accounting for the allowance for doubtful accounts, income taxes, provisions for legal claims and others, depreciations and recoverable value of assets. Actual results could be significantly different from such
      estimates.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_5375cb1aa3a146beb0672d250a4356ee6" continuedAt="Text_5375cb1aa3a146beb0672d250a4356ee7">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_5375cb1aa3a146beb0672d250a4356ee7" continuedAt="Text_5375cb1aa3a146beb0672d250a4356ee8">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The presentation in the statement of financial position distinguishes between current and non-current assets and liabilities. The assets and liabilities are those
      expected to be realized or settled within twelve months after the end of the reporting period under review, and those held for sale. The fiscal year begins on January 1 and ends on December 31 of each year. The economic and financial results are
      presented on a fiscal year basis.</div>
</ix:continuation>

            a Single Transaction &#8211; Amendments to </span><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">IAS 12</span>: &#8220;Income tax&#8221;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d11" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d12"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd9" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd10">
<div><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d12" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d13"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd10" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd11">
<div style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">IAS 12 - Income Tax specifies how an entity accounts for income tax, including deferred tax, which represents tax to be paid or recovered in future periods.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d13" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d14"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd11" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd12">
<div style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
          </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d14" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d15"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd12" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd13">
<div style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">The amendments clarify that the exemption defined in the standard to recognize deferred taxes when assets or liabilities are recognized for the first time is not applicable in the case of leases and provisions for decommissioning.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d15" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d16"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd13" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd14">

<div style="margin: 0px 0px 0px 0pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"> <span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><br/>
          </span></div>

<div><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d20" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d21"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd18" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd19">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">This amendment did not have a significant impact on the Company&#180;s consolidated financial statements.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d21" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d22"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd19" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd20">

          </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d22" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d23"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd20" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd21">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Definition of Accounting Estimates <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">&#8211;</span> Amendments to IAS 8: &#8220;Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors&#8221;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d23" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d24"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd21" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd22">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;"> <br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d24" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d25"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd22" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd23">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In February 2021, the IASB issued amendments to IAS 8, introducing a definition of &#8220;accounting estimates&#8221;. The amendments clarify the
            distinction between changes in accounting estimates and changes in accounting policies and the correction of errors. They also clarify how entities use measurement techniques and inputs to develop accounting estimates.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d25" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d26"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd23" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd24">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">Disclosure of Accounting Policies &#8211; Amendments to IAS 1: Presentation of Financial Statements and IFRS </span><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">&#8211; Practice Statement 2: Making Materiality Judgements</span><br/>
            <br/>
          </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d31" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d32"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd29" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd30">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In February 2021, the IASB issued amendments to IAS 1 and IFRS Accounting Standards Practice Statement 2, Making Materiality, providing
            guidance and examples to help entities apply disclosure materiality judgments on accounting policies. The purpose of the amendments is to help entities provide information about accounting policies that is more useful, by replacing the
            requirement that entities disclose their &#8220;significant&#8221; accounting policies with &#8220;material&#8221; accounting policies and by adding guidance on how Entities apply the concept of materiality when making decisions about disclosures regarding accounting
            policies.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d32" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d33"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd30" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd31">

<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The modifications are effective for annual reporting periods that began on or after January 1, 2023.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
