</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d38" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d39"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd36" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd37">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d39" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d40"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd37" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd38">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">In December 2021, the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) released the Pillar Two
              model rules (the Global Anti-Base Erosion Proposal, or &#8216;GloBE&#8217;) to reform international corporate taxation. Large multinational enterprises within the scope of the rules are required to calculate their GloBE effective tax rate for each
              jurisdiction where they operate. They will be liable to pay a top-up tax for the difference between their GloBE effective tax rate per jurisdiction and the 15% minimum rate.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d40" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d41"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd38" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd39">

<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>

<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">In May 2023, the IASB made narrow-scope amendments to IAS 12 which provide a temporary relief from the
              requirement to recognise and disclose deferred taxes arising from enacted or substantively enacted tax law that implements the Pillar Two model rules, including tax law that implements qualified domestic minimum top-up taxes described in
              those rules.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d55" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d56"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd53" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd54">

<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">On January 23, 2020, the IASB issued the classification of debt as current and non-current, which amends IAS 1
              Presentation of Financial Statements. These amendments affect the requirements of IAS 1 for the presentation of debt.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d56" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d57"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd54" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd55">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d57" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d58"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd55" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd56">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">Specifically, it clarifies the criteria for classifying debt as non-current. The date of application of the
              amendment was set for fiscal years beginning on or after January 1, 2024, with retroactive application.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d58" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d59"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd56" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd57">

              conditions with which an entity must comply within twelve months after the reporting period affect the classification of a liability.</div>

The
              modifications include new requirements for qualitative and quantitative information regarding financing agreements with financial providers that allow evaluating the effects of these agreements on liabilities, cash flows and exposure to
              liquidity risk.</div>

              entity owes to its commercial supplier and (ii) the entity pays the financial provider, according to the terms of the agreement.</div>

<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">On August 15, 2023, the IASB issued the modification to IAS 21 called &#8220;Lack of Exchangeability&#8221; to provide
              guidelines in the latter case. The amendment requires entities to apply a consistent approach to evaluating whether a currency can be exchanged for another currency, and if not, determining the exchange rate to use for measurement purposes
              and the disclosures that need to be provided in its financial statements.</div>

            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d83" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d84"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd81" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd82">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">Once the absence of exchangeability between currencies has been identified, the exchange rate must be
              estimated that represents that which would be obtained in an orderly transaction between market participants and that reflects economic conditions. These modifications do not specify a methodology for estimating the exchange rate to be used,
              but rather it must be developed by each entity.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d84" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d85"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd82" continuedAt="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd83">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#160;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d85" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d86"><ix:continuation id="Text_46c041022ec847778b967ca4d392dbdd83">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; text-align: justify;">The amendments are effective for annual reporting periods beginning on or after January 1, 2025. Early
              adoption is permitted.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d89" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d90"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd62" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd63">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">4.b.1) Subsidiaries</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d90" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d91"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd63" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd64">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d91" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d92"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd64" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd65">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Subsidiaries are all entities over which the Company has control. The Company controls an entity when the Company is exposed to, or has rights to, variable returns
        from its involvement and has the ability to affect those returns through its power over the entity. Subsidiaries are fully consolidated from the date on which control is transferred to the group. They are deconsolidated from the date that control
        ceases. For this purpose and unless there are specific requirements, it is generally considered that <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> has control, when it has a participation equal to or greater than 50% of the available voting rights.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d92" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d93"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd65" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd66">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%17%F-%%-->
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d93" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d94"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd66" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd67">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The accounting policies of the subsidiaries are consistent with the accounting policies adopted by the Company.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d94" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d95"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd67" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd68">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d95" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d96"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd68" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd69">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Inter-company transactions, balances and profit or loss from transactions between group companies are eliminated. Unrealized profit or loss are also eliminated.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">4.b.2) Associates<br/>
        </span> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>

</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d106" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d107"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd619" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd620">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Associates are entities over which the group has significant influence but not control, generally accompanying a shareholding of between 20% and 50% of the voting
        rights. Investments in associates are accounted for using the equity method of accounting. Under the equity method, the investment is initially recognized at cost, and the carrying amount is increased or decreased to recognize the investor&#8217;s share
        of the profit or loss of the investee after the date of acquisition.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d107" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d108"><ix:continuation id="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd620" continuedAt="Text_79d09a6f2a8b4c9e8180ad46142c2cd621">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company accounted for the investments in its associates, under the equity method on the basis on the financial statements as of September 30, 2023 of <span style="font-style: italic;">Gas Link S.A</span>. (&#8220;Link&#8221;) and <span style="font-style: italic;">Transporte y Servicios de Gas en Uruguay SA</span> (&#8220;TGU&#8221;). Accounting policies of associates have been changed where necessary to ensure consistency
        with the policies adopted by the Company. The Company&#8217;s management is not aware of any significant subsequent events which affected the financial statements as of September 30, 2023 of Link and TGU from this date to December 31, 2<span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">023.</span></div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">As indicated in &#8220;Note 23 &#8211; Associates and Joint Arrangement&#8221;, on August 7, 2017, the Company proceeded to create a UT (similar to a joint operation) <span style="font-style: italic;">with SACDE Sociedad Argentina de Construcci&#243;n y Desarrollo Estrat&#233;gico S.A.</span> (&#8220;SACDE&#8221;) (&#8220;UT&#8221;). <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">4.d.1) Regulatory framework</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d143" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d144"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71073" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71074">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d144" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d145"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71074" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71075">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2023, including comparative figures, have been restated to take into account changes in the general purchasing
        power of the Company&#8217;s functional currency (the Argentine peso) in accordance with IAS 29 &#8220;Financial Reporting in hyperinflationary economies&#8221; (&#8220;IAS 29&#8221;) and CNV General Resolution No. 777/2018. As a result, the financial statements are stated in
        terms of the current unit of measurement at the 2023 balance sheet date.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d145" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d146"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71075" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71076">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d146" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d147"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71076" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71077">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">IAS 29 requires that the financial statements of an entity that reports in the currency of a hyperinflationary economy, regardless of whether they are based on the
        historical cost method or the current cost method, are expressed in terms of the current unit of measurement at the closing date of the reporting period. In order to conclude on the existence of a hyperinflationary economy, the standard details a
        series of factors to be considered, among which is a cumulative inflation rate over three years that approaches or exceeds 100%.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d147" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d148"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71077" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71078">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
        <div class="BRPFPageFooter" style="width: 100%;"></div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The accumulated inflation in three years is over 100%. Likewise, both the National Government projections and other available projections indicate that this trend will
        not be reversed in the short term.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d149" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d150"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da71079" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710710">

        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d150" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d151"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710710" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710711">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">To evaluate the aforementioned quantitative condition, and also to restate the financial statements, the CNV has established that the series of indexes to be used for
        the application of IAS 29 is determined by the FACPCE. This series of indexes combines the National Consumer Price Index (&#8220;CPI&#8221;) as of January 2017 (base month: December 2016) with the Domestic Wholesale Price Index (&#8220;IPIM&#8221;), both published by the
        Institute National Statistics and Census (&#8220;INDEC&#8221;) until that date. For the months of November and December 2015, for which there is no information from the INDEC on the evolution of the IPIM, the variation in the CPI of the Autonomous City of
        Buenos Aires was applied.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d151" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d152"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710711" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710712">

        </span> </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Considering the aforementioned index, inflation was <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:InflationRatePercentage" id="Fact_6f72dd77ae034db18aef19b7b890b8c0" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="4" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">211.40</ix:nonFraction>%,
        <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:InflationRatePercentage" id="Fact_7c306c707f664210a1444566d315e0f2" contextRef="c20220101to20221231" unitRef="U004" decimals="4" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">94.79</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:InflationRatePercentage" id="Fact_78baec64f6b5481aa937338cef909c03" contextRef="c20210101to20211231" unitRef="U004" decimals="4" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">50.94</ix:nonFraction>% in the
        years ended December 31, 2023, 2022 and 2021 respectively.</div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d154" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d155"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710714" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710715">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">4.d.2) Restatement mechanism</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d155" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d156"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710715" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710716">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d156" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d157"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710716" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710717">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The financial statements must be adjusted to consider changes in the general purchasing power of the currency, so that they are expressed in the current unit of
        measurement at the end of the reporting period. Said requirements also include all the comparative information of the financial statements, without modifying the decisions made based on the financial information corresponding to those financial
        years.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d157" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d158"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710717" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710718">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d158" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d159"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710718" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710719">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The figures as of December 31, 2022 and 2021, which are presented in these Consolidated Financial Statements for comparative purposes, arise from the restatement to
        the current unit of measure of the Financial Statements as of said dates, in accordance with IAS 29.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d159" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d160"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710719" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710720">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d160" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d161"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710720" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710721">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Restatement of the balance sheet</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d161" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d162"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710721" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710722">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d162" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d163"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710722" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710723">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">i. Monetary items (those with a fixed nominal value in local currency) are not restated, since they are already expressed in the current unit of measurement at the
        closing date of the reporting period. In an inflationary period, maintaining monetary assets generates loss of purchasing power and maintaining monetary liabilities generates a gain in purchasing power, provided that such items are not subject to
        an adjustment mechanism that compensates to some extent for these effects. The monetary loss or gain is included in the result of the period in which it is reported.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d163" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d164"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710723" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710724">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d164" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d165"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710724" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710725">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">ii. The non-monetary items measured at their current values at the end of the reporting period are not restated for the purpose of their presentation in the balance
        sheet, but the adjustment process must be completed to determine in terms of a homogeneous unit of measurement the results produced by the holding of these non-monetary items.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d165" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d166"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710725" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710726">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d166" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d167"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710726" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710727">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">iii. Non-monetary items measured at historical cost or at a fair value as of a date prior to the closing date of the reporting period are restated by coefficients that
        reflect the variation in the general price level from the date of acquisition or revaluation to the closing date, proceeding then to compare the restated amounts of those assets with the corresponding recoverable values.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">iv. The restatement of non-monetary assets in the terms of the current unit of measurement at the end of the reporting period without an equivalent adjustment for tax
        purposes, results in a temporary taxable difference and the recognition of a deferred tax liability whose counterparty is recognized in the result of the period. For the closing of the subsequent period, the deferred tax items are restated for
        inflation to re-determine the charge to the result of the next period.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Restatement of the Comprehensive Income Statement</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d173" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d174"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710733" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710734">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d174" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d175"><ix:continuation id="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710734" continuedAt="Text_b35e9578129949f2a4924ffd16da710735">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Revenues and expenses (including interest and foreign exchange differences) are restated from the date of their booking, except for those items of the result that
        reflect or include in their determination the consumption of assets measured in purchasing power of a date before the consumption booked, which are restated based on the date of origin of the asset to which the item is related (for example,
        depreciation and other consumption of assets measured at historical cost); and also those results that arise from comparing two measurements expressed in purchasing power currency of different dates, for which it is necessary to identify the
        amounts compared, restate them separately, and make the comparison, but with the amounts already restated.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">It is the most relevant category used by the Company, financial assets are classified and measure at amortized cost if both of the following conditions are met:</div>

<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" class="DSPFListTable" style="width: 100%; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

                  <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</div>
                </td>

    <td style="align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                  <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">The financial asset is held within a business model with the objective to hold financial assets in order to collect contractual cash flows; and</div>
                </td>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company applies the Expected Credit loss (&#8220;ECL&#8221;) model for those financial assets accounted for at amortized cost or at fair value through OCI. The ECL is based on

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d287" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d288"><ix:continuation id="Text_22929ea424084d51b1572cfbdcb8c89e3">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
        Derivative financial instruments are measured in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards 13 &#8220;Fair value measurement&#8221;.<br/>
        <br/>
        The method of recognizing the resulting gain or loss depends on whether the derivative is designated as a hedging instrument or not and, according to the nature of the item being hedged.<br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d288" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d289">

        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d289" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d290"><ix:nonNumeric name="ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForMeasuringInventories" id="Text_793be9aebed14626bf307ef993ceb450" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc1">

          <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" class="DSPFListTable" style="width: 100%; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 18pt;">
                  <div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">4.g)</div>
                </td>

    <td style="align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                  <div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Inventories</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d291" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d292"><ix:continuation id="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc2" continuedAt="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc3">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Inventories consist of natural gas (in excess of the &#8220;Line Pack&#8221;, classified as property, plant and equipment) in the Company&#8217;s pipeline system, and the liquids stored
        obtained from natural gas processing at the Cerri Complex.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d292" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d293"><ix:continuation id="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc3" continuedAt="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc4">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d293" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d294"><ix:continuation id="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc4" continuedAt="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc5">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Inventories are measured at the lower of cost restated for the inflation effects as mentioned in Note 4.d. or net realizable value. Cost is determined using the
        weighted average cost method. The cost of inventories includes expenditure incurred in purchasing and production and other necessary costs to bring them to their existing location and condition.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d294" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d295"><ix:continuation id="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc5" continuedAt="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc6">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d295" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d296"><ix:continuation id="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc6" continuedAt="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc7">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The net realizable value is the estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business less the estimated cost of completion and the estimated costs to make the
        sale.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d296" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d297"><ix:continuation id="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc7" continuedAt="Text_2c82b7930fe74090bbaa10aeeaf0b0dc8">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The assessment of the recoverable value of these assets is made at each reporting date, and the resulting loss is recognized in the statement of comprehensive income
        when the inventories are overstated.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        </span> </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d301" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d302"><ix:continuation id="Text_f7607bcc9a0d4f87b64f596f0dc372042" continuedAt="Text_f7607bcc9a0d4f87b64f596f0dc372043">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Trade receivables are amounts due from customers for goods and services performed in the ordinary course of business.
          Contract assets are unbilled amounts due to customers related to works in progress.<br/>
        </span> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d302" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d303"><ix:continuation id="Text_f7607bcc9a0d4f87b64f596f0dc372043" continuedAt="Text_f7607bcc9a0d4f87b64f596f0dc372044">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Trade receivables, contract assets and other receivables are recognized initially at fair value and subsequently measured
          at amortized cost using the effective interest method, less allowance for trade receivables.<br/>
        </span> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d303" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d304"><ix:continuation id="Text_f7607bcc9a0d4f87b64f596f0dc372044" continuedAt="Text_f7607bcc9a0d4f87b64f596f0dc372045">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company applies the simplified approach to measuring expected credit losses for trade receivables, contract assets and other receivables. For this purpose,
        customers have been grouped based on shared credit risk characteristics, the existence of guarantees, historical credit losses experienced and the existence of judicial proceedings aimed at obtaining payment. Once each group was defined, an
        expected uncollectibility rate calculated based on historic default rates adjusted to future economic conditions was defined.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Other items of PPE:</span><span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">&#160;<span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">have been valued at acquisition cost restated for the effects&#160;of inflation as mentioned in Note 4.d, and net of accumulated depreciation. <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Subsequent costs restated for the effects of inflation as mentioned in Note 4.d. are included in the carrying amount of the asset or recognized as a separate
            asset, as appropriate, only when it is probable that future economic benefits associated with the item will flow to the Company and the cost of the item can be reliably measured. The carrying amount of a replaced component is written off. In
            the same way, when a major maintenance is carried out, they are added to the cost of the equipment if the recognition criteria are satisfied, eliminating any remaining non-depreciated remaining value restated for the effects of inflation as
            mentioned in Note 4.d, if any, of previous overhaul.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d327" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d328"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78416" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78417">

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">In this sense, Resolutions No. 1660/2000 (&#8220;Resolution 1660&#8221;) and No. 1903/2000 (&#8220;Resolution 1903&#8221;) issued by ENARGAS include definitions about the costs that
            should be considered as improvements or maintenance expenses. All other repairs and maintenance are charged to the statement of comprehensive income when incurred.</div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">In accordance with IAS 23, the Company capitalizes financial expense on long term construction projects, until the moment in which the asset is in conditions for
            its use. Capitalization of borrowing costs is carried out considering the provisions of IAS 29, recording as an expense in the Statement of Comprehensive Income the part of the borrowing costs that compensates for inflation during the same
            period. As of December 31, 2023 and 2022 there have not been capitalized borrowing costs.</div>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Depreciation related to natural gas transportation assets is computed under the straight-line method over the estimated useful lives of the specific assets, which

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Major maintenance costs are depreciated according to the estimated time until the next major maintenance planned. Regarding the capitalized financial costs, they

          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d348" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d349"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78437" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78438">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Where the carrying amount of an individual asset or CGU exceeds its recoverable amount, the individual asset or CGU, as the case may be, is considered impaired and
            is written down to its recoverable amount. Impairment losses are recognized in the consolidated statement of comprehensive income.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d349" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d350"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78438" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78439">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
            </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d350" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d351"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78439" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78440">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">In assessing value in use, the estimated future cash flows are discounted to their present value using a pre-tax discount rate that reflects current market
            assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the asset for which the estimates of future cash flows have not been adjusted. To such end, the management makes estimates and assumptions of the economic conditions that will
            prevail throughout the useful life of the assets.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d351" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d352"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78440" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78441">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
            </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d352" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d353"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78441" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78442">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">As a result of the factors mentioned above, actual cash flows and values could vary significantly from projected cash flows and the values derived from the
            discounting techniques used.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d353" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d354"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78442" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78443">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
            </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d354" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d355"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78443" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78444">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Impairment losses, if any, are recognized in the statement of comprehensive income.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d355" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d356"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78444" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78445">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
            </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d356" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d357"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78445" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78446">
<div style="text-align: justify;"> <span style="font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">As of December 31, 2023 and 2022, the
              book value of PPE did not exceed its recoverable value.</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        </div>

      </div>

      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d357" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d358"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78446" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78447">
<div><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <div>
          <div style="text-align: justify;">
            <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">
              <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d358" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d359"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78447" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78448">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Infrastructure used in the natural gas transportation service: </span><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">for its measurement and disclosure, the Company has evaluated the application of Interpretation No. 12 &#8220;Service
                  Concession Agreements&#8221; (IFRIC 12) that sets the guidelines for the accounting of private entities that provide public services through a service concession agreement or a contract of a similar nature.</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d359" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d360"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78448" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78449">
<div><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
          </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%28%F-%%--> </div>

      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
        <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
          <div>
            <div style="text-align: justify;">
              <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">
                <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d360" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d361"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78449" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78450">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Considering the current terms and conditions of the License, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> concluded that the License is outside the scope of
                  IFRIC 12, as it is considered in substance to provide for an indefinite term because the infrastructure will never revert to the grantor and due to the characteristics of renewal of the License that give a similar result to what which
                  would result from having obtained a perpetual right to operate the infrastructure.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d361" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d362"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78450" continuedAt="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78451">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
                  </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
                <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d362" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d363"><ix:continuation id="Text_daedab5da913495c9f242c2f7a84b78451">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">The evaluation carried out and the conclusions reached by <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> are consistent with those of other transportation and
                  natural gas distribution companies in Argentina that are subject to the similar regulations and license agreements. The evaluation was carried out jointly, when the transportation and distribution companies adopted the IFRS Accounting
                  Standards in Argentina in 2012, together with the FACPCE, the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange (Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos -&#8220;BYMA&#8221;) and the CNV, considering the contributions of ENARGAS with respect to the regulatory aspects of the License
                  agreements. In this regard, the CNV issued General Resolution No. 613/2012, ratifying that IFRIC 12 does not apply to natural gas transportation and distribution licenses established under the regulatory framework described in Note 17.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d365" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d366"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b1" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b2">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d366" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d367"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b2" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b3">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Leases are recognized as a right-of-use asset and a corresponding liability at the date on which the leased asset is available for use by the Company. Each lease
        payment is allocated between the liability and the finance cost. The finance cost is expensed over the lease term to produce a constant periodic interest rate on the remaining balance of the liability for each period. The right-of-use asset is
        depreciated over the shorter of the useful life of the asset or the term of the contract.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d367" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d368"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b3" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b4">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d368" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d369"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b4" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b5">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Assets and liabilities arising from a lease are initially measured based on the present value of the lease. Liabilities include the net present value of the following
        lease payments:</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d369" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d370"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b5" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b6">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div>
        <div>
          <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d370" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d371"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b6" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b7">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 36pt;"><span style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">a) </span>Fixed payments, less any incentive receivable;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        </div>

      </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d371" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d372"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b7" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b8">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">b) Variable lease payments;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d372" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d373"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b8" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b9">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">c) Amounts expected to be collected as a guarantee of the residual value;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d373" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d374"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b9" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b10">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">d) The exercise price of the lease option; and</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d374" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d375"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b10" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b11">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">e) Penalty payments for termination of the lease.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d375" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d376"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b11" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b12">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d376" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d377"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b12" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b13">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Lease payments are discounted using the interest rate implicit in the lease. If such rate cannot be determined, the Company&#8217;s incremental borrowing rate is used, which
        is the rate that <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> would have to pay to borrow the funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar value in a similar economic environment.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d377" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d378"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b13" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b14">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d378" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d379"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b14" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b15">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Right-of-use assets are measured at cost which comprises the following:</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d379" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d380"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b15" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b16">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d380" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d381"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b16" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b17">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">a) The amount of the initial measurement of the lease liability;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d381" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d382"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b17" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b18">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">b) Any lease payments made on or before the commencement date less any lease incentives received;</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d382" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d383"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b18" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b19">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">c) Any initial direct costs; and</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d383" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d384"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b19" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b20">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">d) Restoration costs</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d385" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d386"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b21" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b22">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">These assets, which are subject to the risk of impairment, are depreciated on a straight-line basis over the shorter of the useful life of the leased asset or the
        lease term.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d386" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d387"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b22" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b23">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Payments associated with short-term leases and low-value assets are recognized on a straight-line basis as an expense in the Statement of Income. Short-term leases are
        those with a term of 12 months or less. Low-value assets comprise computer equipment, vehicles, small items of office furniture and real estate.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d388" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d389"><ix:continuation id="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b24" continuedAt="Text_c564e1e9d1624c8383d8f4ef9173836b25">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company has rights to use assets that are shown as part of Property, plant and equipment (see Note 12). Lease liabilities are shown under Financial Debt (see Note
        13). For further information regarding the expense related to short-term and low value leases and the interest expense on lease liabilities, see Note 8.j. and 8.k., respectively.</div>

        relate to income tax levied by the same tax authority on the same taxable entity or different taxable entities that intend to settle tax assets and liabilities on a net basis. Deferred tax assets are recognized to the extent that it is probable

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">At the end of each month, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> recognizes, over the time, its revenues from sales equivalent to the firm reserved capacity, the
        volumes of natural gas transported under the modalities of interruptible and exchange and displacement and by the operation and maintenance services. In return, a trade receivable is recognized which represents an unconditional right that the
        Company has to receive the consideration owed by the customer. On the other hand, the billing of the service is done monthly and according to the guidelines established by ENARGAS, the consideration is received within said calendar month.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d440" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d441"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a15" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a16">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d443" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d444"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a18" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a19">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">This business segment includes: (i) production and commercialization of liquids, and (ii) other liquid services.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d444" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d445"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a19" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a20">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d445" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d446"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a20" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a21">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Liquids Production and Commercialization in the domestic market</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d446" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d447"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a21" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a22">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d447" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d448"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a22" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a23">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In the domestic market, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> sells the production of propane and butane to LPG retailers in the framework of the programs
        created by the National Government to supply the domestic market. The sale prices are determined by the ex-Secretary of Hydrocarbon Resources (&#8220;SHR&#8221;). For more information, see Note 17 - Regulatory framework &#8211; b) Regulatory framework for
        non-regulated segments - to these consolidated financial statements.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d448" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d449"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a23" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a24">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d449" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d450"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a24" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a25">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The price of those tons of propane and butane that are not sold within the framework of the aforementioned programs is determined by the Secretary of Energy based on
        the international reference prices.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d450" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d451"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a25" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a26">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d451" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d452"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a26" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a27">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Regarding ethane sales, they are made to PBB Polisur S.R.L. (&#8220;PBB&#8221;), the only customer to whom this product is sold. To estimate transaction price, the Company uses
        the most probable amount method. In this regard, the Company only recognizes those transactions where it is highly probable that they will not be reversed in the future.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d452" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d453"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a27" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a28">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Liquids Production and Commercialization in the foreign market</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d454" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d455"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a29" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a30">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d455" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d456"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a30" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a31">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In the foreign market, the Company markets propane, butane and natural gasoline to international traders (&#8220;traders&#8221;) and other clients of worldwide renown, some of
        them through trucks.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d456" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d457"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a31" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a32">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d457" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d458"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a32" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a33">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">These sales are made under short-term contracts (less than one year), with the price determined as reference to international prices plus / minus a fixed amount per
        ton sold.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d458" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d459"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a33" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a34">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d459" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d460"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a34" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a35">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">For both domestic and foreign market sales, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> transfers control and recognizes revenues when the products are delivered to
        the customer and therefore the product has been accepted and there is no evidence of the existence of pending obligations by the Company. It is at that moment when a trade receivable is recognized given that the receipt of the consideration is
        unconditional and only the passage of time is the only requirement for receiving the consideration owed by the customer.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d460" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d461"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a35" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a36">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Revenues are recognized when the service is effectively
        rendered, that is, after the dispatch to each vessel. The price is agreed by the parties being a fixed amount per ton of product dispatched, there being no variable components in them. These services are billed monthly, at which time an
        unconditional right to receive the consideration from the client arises.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d466" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d467"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a41" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a42">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d467" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d468"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a42" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a43">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Midstream</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d469" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d470"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a44" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a45">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d470" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d471"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a45" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a46">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The services included in the Midstream segment consist mainly in (i) treatment, removal of impurities and natural gas compression, including the collection and
        transport of natural gas (ii) inspection and maintenance of pipelines and compressor plants, (iii) services of steam generation for electricity production and management services for expansion works and steam generation for the production of
        electricity and (iv) natural gas transportation services in Vaca Muerta.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d471" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d472"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a46" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a47">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
