      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d472" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d473"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a47" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a48">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Revenues from sales of this business segment are recognized over the time in the period in which the service is provided. The sale price is determined according to
        what arises from the contractual conditions agreed between <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> and its customers. In all cases, the recognition and billing of sales income is made on a monthly basis so that at that time a sales credit is
        recorded.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d473" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d474"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a48" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a49">

        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d474" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d475"><ix:continuation id="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a49" continuedAt="Text_6d60bd74f8cc455cb7ed34475c0ad11a50">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Revenues from the participation in the joint venture, which correspond to the construction activities provided by the joint venture, are recognized based on the stage
        of completion of the contractual activity (percentage of completion method), considering the estimated final margin of the work. To apply the percentage of completion method, the revenue recognized at the end of the period will correspond to the
        total contractual revenue multiplied by the actual percentage of completion, based on the proportion of the total direct contractual costs incurred to date, and the total direct contractual costs, including the estimated costs to complete the
        construction. Costs incurred in excess of the costs associated with revenue are recognized in Contract assets.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">Corresponds to the reclassification of the nominal value and corresponding restatement in constant peso (Inflation
          Adjustment to Common Stock) of shares issued and repurchased by the Company in market transactions, as required by the current regulations of the CNV.<br/>
        </span> <span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d506" continuedAt="Text_fb4be73cc7de41ab98b34f592b01490d507"><ix:continuation id="Text_dbe0daf341bd4ad3860e25cfc1da32a712" continuedAt="Text_dbe0daf341bd4ad3860e25cfc1da32a713">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Own equity instruments that are reacquired (treasury shares) are recognized at cost restated for the inflation effects as mentioned in Note 4.d), and deducted from
        equity. No gain or loss is recognized on the purchase, sale or cancellation of the Company&#8217;s treasury shares. Any difference between the carrying amount and the consideration, if reissued, is recognized as a premium on common stock or additional
        paid-up capital.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

        accumulated losses of prior years, when this aggregate amount exceeds zero until the legal reserve equals <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfLegalReserveOnSumOfCapitalStockAndAdjustmentToCapitalStockBalances" id="Fact_2da19a0edcc44a9797de84314d63f6a4" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">20</ix:nonFraction>% of the sum of Capital
        stock and Adjustment to capital stock balances.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The preparation of financial statements in conformity with professional accounting standards requires the Company to make accounting estimates that affect the reported
      amounts of assets and liabilities and the disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the financial statements and the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the reporting period. The making of such estimates involves <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> using assumptions and presumptions that are based on a number of factors, including past trends, events known at the date of issuance of these financial statements, and expectations of future events and their
      outcomes.</div>

          4.j), management periodically evaluates the existence of significant events or changes that could have an adverse effect on the Company or will take place in the near future that could affect the recoverable amount of PPE. PPE is tested to assess
          whether an impairment or reversal of a previous impairment is required when significant changes took place during the period or will take place in the near future indicate that the recoverable value of the PPE amounts may be affected. These
          evaluations are performed at the lowest level for which identifiable cash flows exist, i.e., for each CGU. The Management considers each business segment as a CGU.</div>

    <ix:continuation id="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca18" continuedAt="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca19">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Since August 2019, the main macroeconomic and business variables in Argentina suffered a significant deterioration. This situation was aggravated in 2020 by the negative
      consequences that COVID had on Argentina&#8217;s economic situation which led the Argentine Government to take a series of measures even affecting the regulatory framework of the natural gas transportation segment (see Notes 1 and 17). Given these
      indicators of impairment of the book value of PPE, the recoverable value of Natural Gas Transportation segment CGU has been calculated based on its value in use as of December 31, 2023.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca19" continuedAt="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca20">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%36%%%-->
    <ix:continuation id="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca20" continuedAt="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca21">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The value in use of PPE is sensitive to significant variation in the assumptions applied, including the determination of future tariffs determined by the Argentine
      Government in the Natural Gas Transportation segment.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca21" continuedAt="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca22">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
      <div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">
        <ix:continuation id="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca22" continuedAt="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca23">
<div style="text-align: justify; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">The value in use is calculated based on the basis of
            discounted future cash flows. The projected cash flows are prepared taking into account significant assumptions relating to: (i) discount rate, (ii) estimates of future tariff adjustments and the recognition of cost adjustments, (iii) expected
            macroeconomic variables such as inflation and foreign exchange rates. The discount rate is based on a weighted average cost of capital (&#8220;WACC&#8221;).</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca23" continuedAt="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca24">
<div><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca24" continuedAt="Text_047a08b0507f414bb218c1ba6dad93ca25">
<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In performing the analysis for the Natural Gas Transportation segment, management considered among others: (i) the status of the negotiations with
        the Argentine Government, (ii) the contractual rights derived from the License, (iii) Management&#180;s expectations with respect to the transitional tariff increase to be granted until the new RTI is finalized, (iv) Management&#180;s expectation of the
        outcome of the new RTI process and (v) the impact of a cost monitoring scheme that allows for semi-annual adjustments to current tariffs.</div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Management has prepared, for the Natural Gas Transportation segment, three different estimates of the expected cash flows by sensitizing its main
        variables (as described above) and assigning probabilities of occurrence based on experience and considering the current socio-economic context, as follows:</div>
</ix:continuation>

        accordance with the probabilities mentioned above, to determine the expected value in use. </span> </div>

      improving the evaluation of contingencies, there will be changes in the estimates of future charges, which could have an impact on the Company&#8217;s future results and its economic and/or financial situation.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">IFRS Accounting Standards 8 &#8220;Operating Segments&#8221; requires an entity to report financial and descriptive information about its reportable segments, which are operating
      segments or aggregations of operating segments that meet specified criteria. Operating segments are components of an entity about which separate financial information is available that is evaluated regularly by the chief operating decision maker
      (&#8220;CODM&#8221;) in deciding how to allocate resources and in assessing performance. The Company&#8217;s CODM is the Board of Directors.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_9d22b05f32144244a5f1161ef2b0a3e33" continuedAt="Text_9d22b05f32144244a5f1161ef2b0a3e34">

      income, costs, expenses, assets and liabilities adopted in the past or the comparative information presented.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>

      (i) Natural Gas Transportation Services, subject to ENARGAS regulations, (ii) Liquids Production and Commercialization, (iii) Midstream and (iv) Telecommunications. These last three business segments are not regulated by ENARGAS. Liquids Production

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c2" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c3">
<div><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Applicable rate</span>
      <br/></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c3" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c4">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c4" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c5">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Until the fiscal year ended on December 31, 2017, the income tax rate remained at <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_0e0b231b33be4dbea7ebba54311070b0" contextRef="c20170101to20171231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">35</ix:nonFraction>%. The tax reform establishes a gradual reduction of the applicable rate for the calculation of income tax, being <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_e49e927b5b19477889778cf81d6bfa7b" contextRef="c20180101to20181231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_c24e719779924a18a690b683984bd608" contextRef="c20200101to20201231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_c019157bba8d44878f58216800c1b0c6" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_MaturityAxis_YearTwoMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_1871a49f37c94a7bbd594895c8d94ae8" contextRef="c20190101to20191231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">30</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>%
        and <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_828acc79aafb43e7a898c5a2729ce04a" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_MaturityAxis_YearThreeMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">25</ix:nonFraction>% for fiscal periods beginning on January 1, 2018 and 2019 and January 1, 2020 onwards, respectively.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c5" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c6">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c6" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c7">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The reduction in the applicable rate was complemented by the application of a tax on the distribution of dividends made to human persons and foreign beneficiaries,
        which the Company must withhold and enter the Tax authority as a single and definitive payment when the dividends are paid. This additional tax will be <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:AdditionalTaxComplementedByApplicationOfTaxOnDistributionOfDividendsConditionOne" id="Fact_1d4ec175ed1147dd8be9fe4fde97ccb6" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">7</ix:nonFraction>%
        or <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:AdditionalTaxComplementedByApplicationOfTaxOnDistributionOfDividendsConditionTwo" id="Fact_e3ee7a71d358475bbc3ca41357b87b5e" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">13</ix:nonFraction>%, depending on whether the dividends distributed correspond to earnings of a fiscal period in which the Company was reached at the
        rate of 30% or 25%, respectively.<br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c7" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c8">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c8" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c9">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Solidarity Law suspended until fiscal years starting from 1st January 2021 inclusive, reduced to <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_9325e386f8f04bc7b01bdd81d7a3cddb" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_MaturityAxis_YearFourMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">25</ix:nonFraction>% of the applicable rate and retention of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:AdditionalTaxComplementedByApplicationOfTaxOnDistributionOfDividendsConditionTwo" id="Fact_1fc0c04d88d148a6ba72f3835ad8e42a" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">13</ix:nonFraction>% on dividends.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c9" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c10">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c10" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c11">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On June 16, 2021, &#8220;Law No. 27,630: Amending the Income Tax Law&#8221; was published in the Official Gazette, which, among other issues, introduces a modification in the
        income tax rate effective for the years fiscal or fiscal years beginning on or after January 1, 2021 inclusive. <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">The amendment establishes a tiered system of rates in <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:IncomeTaxLawAccumulatedNetTaxableIncomeTieredSystemNumberOfSegments" id="Fact_576270bf22cb4230874cdcf2e50943c3" contextRef="c20210616" unitRef="U009" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">three</ix:nonFraction>
          segments </span>( <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_47b5ce526d804093a91a26568efcf1e1" contextRef="c20210616to20210616_RegulatoryEnvironmentsAxis_AmendedIncomeTaxLawSegmentOneMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">25</ix:nonFraction>%, <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_7c6036e118054adc89cb53253efe1fcf" contextRef="c20210616to20210616_RegulatoryEnvironmentsAxis_AmendedIncomeTaxLawSegmentTwoMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">30</ix:nonFraction>%
        and <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" id="Fact_9054c82c2ca84f3dac7cbffdfb311faa" contextRef="c20210616to20210616_RegulatoryEnvironmentsAxis_AmendedIncomeTaxLawSegmentThreeMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">35</ix:nonFraction>%) <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">according to the level of accumulated net taxable income, which will be updated.</span> </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c11" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c12">

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> Likewise, dividends distributed to foreign individuals and beneficiaries will be taxed at a rate of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:TaxRateOnDividendsDistributionsToForeignIndividualsAndBeneficiaries" id="Fact_57816f597fbc4b0ab85250ab6f78ce94" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">7</ix:nonFraction>%.<br/>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c16" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c17">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Tax adjustment for inflation</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c17" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c18">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 14.2pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c18" continuedAt="Text_223f69e92ecb49a6924399ef0a09271c19">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Law No. 27,468 establishes that in the net taxable income of the periods beginning on or after January 1, 2018, the adjustment for inflation obtained by the
        application of the income tax law may be deducted or incorporated into the tax result for the fiscal year. This adjustment will proceed only if the percentage variation in the IPC, will accumulate (a) a percentage higher than 100% in the 36 months
        prior to the end of the year, or (b) regarding the first, second and third fiscal year that starts from its effective date, an accumulated variation of the IPC that exceeds 55%, 30% or 15% of said 100%, respectively.</div>
</ix:continuation>

        year beginning on January 1, 2019 will be charged in a sixth in that fiscal period and the <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:NumberOfConsecutiveMonthlyInstallments" id="Fact_a4c03b81c4104362ac2103416b59b7c1" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U011" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">five</ix:nonFraction> sixths remaining in equal parts in the
        following 5 fiscal periods.           <br/>
          The 2023 budget law incorporates article 195 to the income tax law establishing that in the event that the adjustment for tax inflation is applicable and a positive adjustment (profits) arises from it, the first and second fiscal years starting
          on 1 January 2022 inclusive, they may allocate 1/3 in that fiscal period and the remaining 2/3, in equal parts, in the 2 immediately following fiscal periods. For the deferral to be appropriate, it will be necessary for companies to make an
          investment in the purchase, construction, manufacture, processing or definitive import of fixed assets (except automobiles), during each of the 2 fiscal periods immediately following that of the calculation of the first third of the period in
          question, for an amount equal to or greater than $<ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ThresholdAdjustmentForTaxInflationForDeferralOnInvestments" id="Fact_0ee7ecb4c88345209da8a8406d9d253e" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_RangeAxis_BottomOfRangeMember" unitRef="U006" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">30,000,000,000</ix:nonFraction>.<br/>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">As of December 31, 2021, the Company had a specific tax carryforward derived from negative exchange differences for the years 2021 and 2020 generated by financial
        instruments traded abroad for Ps. <span style="font-size: 10pt;"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:GainsLossesOnHedgingInstrument" id="Fact_2fa2856021ea4591806a2233d39d0e18" contextRef="c20210101to20211231_TemporaryDifferenceUnusedTaxLossesAndUnusedTaxCreditsAxis_UnrealisedForeignExchangeGainsLossesMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">11,404,393</ix:nonFraction>. The realization of such tax loss depended on the future
          generation of taxable financial gains taxed during the statute of limitations period. To determine its recoverability, the Company took into consideration the reversal of the deferred items, its tax planning and projections of future specific
          taxable income based on its best estimate. Based on these projections and because it <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">was not possible to estimate as probable the generation of future specific financial gains to absorb such tax loss, no deferred tax asset of </span>Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:UnusedTaxLossesForWhichNoDeferredTaxAssetRecognised" id="Fact_fbf4c635283d442e8ecf4c23383a8ebc" contextRef="c20211231" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">1,135,919</ix:nonFraction> was recognized as of December 31, 2021. <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">During the year ended on December 31, 2022, the tax loss carryforward was totally recovered.</span></span><br/>
        <br/>
      </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-weight: bold;">16.1 Financial risk factors</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d63" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d64">

        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d64" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d65">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company&#8217;s activities and the market in which it operates expose it to a series of financial risks: market risk (including foreign exchange risk,
        interest rate risk, and commodity price risk), credit risk and liquidity risk.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d65" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d66">

      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d66" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d67">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company&#8217;s risk management framework establishes that a risk map is determined that measures the potential impact of each of them on the
        financial situation and results of operations. Based on this, the Executive Officers are responsible for defining the policies, procedures, limits and measures aimed at mitigating the impact of said risks.</div>
</ix:continuation>

</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d613" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d614">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d614" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d615">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Exchange rate risk management</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d615" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d616">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d616" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d617">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In view of the main impacts of the aforementioned situation and those detailed in Note 1 to these Consolidated Financial Statements, the Company has
        implemented a series of measures to mitigate their impact. In this sense, the Company&#8217;s Management permanently monitors the evolution of the situations that affect its business, in order to determine the possible actions to be taken and identify
        the eventual impacts on its equity and financial situation. The Company considers that its current financial position will allow it to comply, in the short term, with its foreign currency commitments. The Company&#8217;s financial statements should be
        read in light of these circumstances.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d617" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d618">

        its entire financial indebtedness is denominated in U.S. dollars. The exposure to other currencies is not significant.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs&#8217;</span> financial risk management policies are defined with the objective of mitigating the impact of exchange
        rate fluctuations on the Company&#8217;s foreign currency position. To this end, alternative investment evaluations are regularly carried out to diversify <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs&#8217;</span> investment portfolio among instruments denominated in
        U.S. dollars or, although denominated in Argentine pesos, to obtain positive returns in real terms.</div>

        dollars. As of December 31, 2023, <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfFundsDenominatedInUSDollars" id="Fact_2ba5351b4c5247f783fa3bf78f58454b" contextRef="c20231231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">91</ix:nonFraction>% of the Company&#8217;s fund placements are denominated in U.S. dollars.</div>

        resulted in a pre-tax loss of Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ProfitLossBeforeTax" id="Fact_7884e55ff00649bd9db166a54bb40657" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" sign="-" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">6,378,820</ix:nonFraction> and Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ProfitLossBeforeTax" id="Fact_917c4627d5c4466aa9ec4220c50079ff" contextRef="c20220101to20221231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" sign="-" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">6,152,241</ix:nonFraction>, respectively. A <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageAppreciationDepreciationRateOfUSDollarAgainstArgentinePeso" id="Fact_79a652e0ac10471087ddcbda11608526" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_TypesOfRisksAxis_CurrencyRiskMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">10</ix:nonFraction>% depreciation of the U.S. dollar against the

        investment in financial instruments to protect its financial position from the devaluation in order to hedge exposure to the risk associated with the exchange rate that derives from its financial debt.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">16.1.2 Interest rate risk</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d637" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d638">

      </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Interest rate risk management seeks to reduce financial costs and limit the Company&#8217;s exposure to increases in interest rates. <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>&#8217; exposure to risks associated with interest rate variations is limited given that all of its financial debt is subject to fixed interest rates. Information regarding the Company&#8217;s financing is disclosed in
        Note 13.</div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d640" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d641">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In addition, the main objective of the Company&#8217;s financial investment activities is to obtain the highest return by investing in low-risk and highly
        liquid instruments. The Company maintains a portfolio of cash equivalents and short-term investments comprised of investments in mutual funds and deposits in interest-bearing bank accounts, public and private securities. The risk of these
        instruments is low since they are mostly short-term and highly liquid in recognized financial institutions.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d641" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d642">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 35.45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d642" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d643">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">As a consequence of the application of IAS 29, maintaining monetary assets generates loss of purchasing power, provided that such items are not
        subject to an adjustment mechanism that compensates to some extent the loss of purchasing power. This loss of purchasing power is included in the result of the period under gain on the net monetary position. On the contrary, maintaining monetary
        liabilities generates a gain in purchasing power, which are also included in such line item.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d643" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d644">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 35.45pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d644" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d645">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company&#8217;s risk management policies are defined with the objective of reducing the impact of the loss of purchasing power. During the 2023, 2022
        and 2021 fiscal years the Company has maintained a liability monetary position. As a consequence, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> has recorded a net gain from exposure to inflation in the monetary items.</div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">16.1.3 Commodity price risk</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d655" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d656">

      </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Commercial operations performed by the Company in its Liquids Production and Commercialization business segment are affected by a number of factors
        beyond its control, including changes in the international prices of the products sold, and government regulations on prices, taxes and other charges, among others.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d657" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d658">

<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The sales prices of exported propane, butane and natural gasoline are determined according to international reference prices (Mont Belvieu for
        propane and butane and NWE ARA for natural gasoline). Additionally, most of the total sales of propane and butane that are made in the domestic market are made at prices set by the Ministry of Energy for the different market segments.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">16.1.4 Credit risk</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d665" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d666">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d666" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d667">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company&#8217;s exposures to credit risk takes the form of a loss that would be recognized if counterparties failed to, or were unable to, meet their
        payment obligations. These risks may arise in certain agreements in relation to amounts owed for physical product sales, the use of derivative instruments, and the investment of surplus cash balances. This risk mainly results from economic and
        financial factors or from a possible default of counterparty.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d667" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d668">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d668" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d669">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company is subject to credit risk arising from outstanding receivables, cash and cash equivalents and deposits with banks and financial
        institutions, and from the use of derivative financial instruments. The Company&#8217;s policy is to manage credit exposure to trading counterparties within defined trading limits.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d669" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d670">

        time that has elapsed since maturity.</div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The credit risk on cash and cash equivalents and other financial placements is limited since <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> has
        short-term fund placement policies whose main objective is to obtain an adequate return based on market characteristics and minimizing risk exposure. These placements are diversified in different financial institutions with adequate credit ratings
        in order to limit exposure to a few financial institutions. The Company&#8217;s maximum exposure to credit risk will be given by the carrying value of assets included in cash and cash equivalents and other financial assets at amortized cost.</div>

<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">16.1.5 Liquidity risk</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6118" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6119">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6119" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6120">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">This risk involves the difficulties that <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> may have in meeting its commercial and financial obligations.
        To this end, the expected cash flow is regularly monitored.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6120" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6121">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6121" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6122">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> has policies for borrowing funds whose main objective is to cover financing needs at the lowest cost
        according to market conditions. One of the Company&#8217;s main objectives is to have financial solvency. Given the current conditions of the financial market, the Company believes that the availability of resources and the positive cash flow from
        operations are sufficient to meet its current obligations, despite having credit lines for borrowing funds.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6122" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6123">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6123" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6124">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Additionally, a methodology is used for the analysis and assignment of credit limits to the different financial entities in order to minimize the
        associated liquidity risk. In line with this, the Company invests its liquid funds in financial entities with an adequate credit rating.</div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">16.1.6 Capital management risk.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6132" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6133">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6133" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6134">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company&#8217;s objectives in managing capital are to safeguard the Company&#8217;s ability to continue as a going concern, to achieve an optimal cost of
        capital structure and to support the investment process in order to provide returns to shareholders and benefits to other stakeholders.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6134" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6135">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6135" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6136">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> seeks to maintain a level of cash generation from its operating activities that will enable it to meet
        all of its commitments.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6136" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6137">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6137" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6138">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Company monitors capital on the basis of the leverage ratio. This ratio is calculated as total financial debt (including &#8220;current financial
        debt&#8221; and &#8220;non-current financial debt&#8221; as shown in the Statement of Financial Position) divided by total capital. Total capital is calculated as &#8220;Shareholders&#8217; Equity&#8221;, as shown in the Statement of Changes in Shareholders&#8217; Equity, plus total
        financial debt.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6138" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6139">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">During the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2022, the gearing ratio was as follows:</div>
</ix:nonNumeric></ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-style: normal; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">16.2.2 Fair value measurement hierarchy and estimates</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6160" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6161">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6161" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6162">
<div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">According to IFRS Accounting Standards 13, the fair value hierarchy introduces three levels of inputs based on the lowest level of input significant
        to the overall fair value. These levels are:</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6162" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6163">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6163" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6164">
<div>
        <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="width: 27pt;">
                <div><br/>
                </div>
              </td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: 18pt; font-size: 8pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span></td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Level 1: includes financial assets and liabilities whose fair values are estimated using quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical assets
                  and liabilities. The instruments included in this level primarily include balances in mutual funds and public or private bonds listed on the Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos S.A. (&#8220;BYMA&#8221;). Within this level, the Company includes those
                  derivate financial instruments for which it was able to find an active market.</div>
              </td>

  </tr>


</table>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6164" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6165">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6165" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6166">
<div>
        <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="width: 27pt;">&#160;</td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: 18pt; font-size: 8pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span></td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Level 2: includes financial assets and liabilities whose fair value is estimated using different assumptions quoted prices included within Level 1 that are
                  observable for the asset or liability, either directly (i.e. as prices) or indirectly (for example, derived from prices).</div>
              </td>

  </tr>


</table>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6166" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6167">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6167" continuedAt="Text_ad6598de9d0646ea85d569d1809a04d6168">
<div>
        <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="width: 27pt;">&#160;</td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: 18pt; font-size: 8pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&#8226;</span></td>

    <td style="text-align: left; vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Level 3: includes financial instruments for which the assumptions used in estimating fair value are not based on observable market information.</div>
              </td>

  </tr>


</table>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc85" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc86">

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Regarding <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>&#8217; Natural Gas Transportation business, it is regulated by Law No. 24,076 (&#8220;the Natural Gas Act&#8221;), its regulatory Decree No. 1,738/92 and the Regulatory framework for the transportation and distribution of
        natural gas in Argentina. The Natural Gas Act created ENARGAS, which is entitled, among other things, to set the basis for the calculation, monitoring, approval of tariffs and the power to verify compliance with the Natural Gas Law and its
        regulations. On January 28, 2016, Resolution No. 7 of the Ministry of Energy and Mining (&#8220;MINEM&#8221;) of Argentina repealed the Resolution 2000/2005 of the former Ministry of Federal Planning, Public Investment and Services (ex &#8220;MPFIPyS&#8221;) which
        provided that all tariff increases should have the prior intervention of the Undersecretary of Coordination and Management Control.</div>

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>&#8217; License has been granted for an original period of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfTransportationLicenseGranted" id="Fact_c662acdeec844d768137e69087beb754" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">35</ix:nonNumeric>
          years beginning on December 28, 1992. However, the Natural Gas Act provides that <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>may apply to ENARGAS for a renewal of its license for an additional period of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfExtensionOnLicenseGranted" id="Fact_04da2db2808e4eda9167aedb4003cfdf" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric>. ENARGAS should evaluate at that time the performance of <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> and raise a recommendation to the Executive Branch. At the end
          of the period of validity of the license, 35 or <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:LicensePeriodAfterRenewal" id="Fact_ac831a138b924a86828d91b97b93447d" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">45</ix:nonNumeric>, as appropriate, the Natural Gas Act requires a call for a new tender for the
          granting of a new license, in which <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, provided the Company fulfilled substantially with the obligations resulting from the license, would have the option of matching the best offer that the Government
          received in this bidding process.</span></div>

        once the regulated procedures and administrative procedure established for this purpose have been completed, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> is granted the extension of the license term for <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TermOfExtensionOnLicenseGrantedForExpirationDate" id="Fact_73d71ee2542c4b16ae2b9d10c51258f9" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">ten years</ix:nonNumeric> from the expiration date of its initial term (December 28, 2027) for the provision of the gas transportation service, contemplating the entire scope of the license
        approved by Decree No. 2458/92.</div>

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Tariff situation</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc817" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc818">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc818" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc819">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Prior the enactment of
        the Public Emergency Law, and according to the Regulatory Framework, transportation tariffs were to be calculated in US dollars and converted into Argentine pesos at the time the customer was billed using the exchange rate prevailing at the date of
        the billing. The basic natural gas transportation tariffs charged by tgs had been established at the time of the privatization of GdE and were to be adjusted, subject to prior authorization, in the following cases: (i) <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:NaturalGasTransportationTariffsPeriodConditionOne" id="Fact_593e087c6c214252ad86e30c4a21cd96" contextRef="c20230101to20231231">semiannually</ix:nonNumeric> to reflect changes in the US producer price index (&#8220;PPI&#8221;) and (ii) every <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:NaturalGasTransportationTariffsPeriodConditionTwo" id="Fact_cd6931726f1749bf89b3d72d0ffbd739" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">five years</ix:nonNumeric> according to efficiency and investment factors determined by ENARGAS. The &#8220;efficiency factor&#8221; was a reduction to the base tariff resulting from future efficiency programs while
        the &#8220;investment factor&#8221; increased the tariffs to compensate the licensees for future investments which were not repaid through tariffs. Also, subject to ENARGAS approval, tariffs were to be adjusted to reflect non-recurrent circumstances or tax
        changes, other than income tax.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc819" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc820">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%75%F-%%-->
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc820" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc821">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The terms and conditions as described in the precedent paragraph in connection with tariff adjustments contemplated within the Regulatory Framework are no longer
        effective since the enactment of the Public Emergency Law in early 2002, which, among other provisions, eliminated tariff increases based on US dollar exchange rate fluctuations, foreign price indexes or any other indexing procedure and established
        a conversion rate of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ConversionRateOfExchangeForTariffs" id="Fact_99ddaa6a3e0648bfae87412112bdf3ac" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">one</ix:nonFraction> peso to <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ConversionRateOfExchangeForTariffs" id="Fact_6d755bbad22a4648b412502d7297b268" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="INF" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">one</ix:nonFraction>
        US dollar for tariffs. The Public Emergency Law also granted the Executive Branch power to renegotiate contracts entered into with private utility companies, pursuant to the framework included in such law as long as it is in force, which expired on
        December 31, 2017, after several extensions.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc821" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc822">

      </div>
</ix:continuation>

        Spanish) process initiated after the Public Emergency Law was passed.</div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc836" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc837">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Semi-annual tariff increase</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc837" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc838">
<div style="margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc838" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc839">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">This increase is granted within the framework of the semi-annual tariff adjustment of the natural gas transportation service in accordance with the provisions of the RTI
        process.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc839" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc840">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc840" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc841">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In the public hearing held on September 4, 2018, in which the Company requested, based on the variation of the WPI recorded for the period February - August 2018, a
        tariff increase of approximately <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariff" id="Fact_9636501a9fc4497d9ffc55e00a9a9fc1" contextRef="c20180904" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">30</ix:nonFraction>%. Considering the hearing, on September 27, 2018, ENARGAS issued Resolution No. 265/2018 which
        determined a <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariff" id="Fact_9c0a86ed86094c8aa2ba6a9c00728280" contextRef="c20181002" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">19.7</ix:nonFraction>% tariff increase effective as of October 1, 2018.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc841" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc842">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc842" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc843">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">This increase was determined by ENARGAS based on the simple average of the WPI, the Construction Cost Index for the period February and August 2018 and the Salary
        Variation Index between December 2017 and June 2018.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc843" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc844">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc844" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc845">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">It is noteworthy that ENARGAS supported the determination of the aforementioned tariff increase in the provisions of Resolution 4362, which, among other issues, provided
        that under certain circumstances and macroeconomic conditions, such as the significant devaluation occurred after April 2018, ENARGAS may use other indexes than the WPI to determine the tariff increase. <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> notified ENARGAS its disagreement with respect to the methodology for calculating the semi-annual adjustment.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc845" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc846">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc846" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc847">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On March 29, 2019, ENARGAS issued Resolution No. 192/2019 (&#8220;Resolution 192&#8221;) that approved, effective as of April 1, 2019, a <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariffOnServiceForNaturalGasTransportation" id="Fact_2e4d0dafcd0c4c68abd021577a09f136" contextRef="c20190401" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">26</ix:nonFraction>% increase in the tariff chart applicable to the public service of natural gas transportation by <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> in force as of March 31, 2019.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc847" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc848">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc848" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc849">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In accordance with current regulations, ENARGAS has considered the evolution of the wholesale price index update index (&#8220;WPI&#8221;) between the months of August 2018 and
        February 2019, in order to define the semi-annual adjustments applicable to <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> tariffs.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc849" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc850">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc850" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc851">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Regarding the semi-annual tariff adjustment that was to be enforced as from October 1, 2019, on September 3, 2019, the SE issued Resolution No. 521/2019 (&#8220;Resolution
        521&#8221;) postponing it to February 1, 2020.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc851" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc852">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%77%F-%%-->
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc852" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc853">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The deferral also meant that the Company reviewed and fit, in equal proportion to the revenue that is no longer received, the execution of the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Fact_6023ad02b8c54382a65de0c6e48aaab0">Five-Year</span> Investment Plan.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc853" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc854">

      </div>

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On <span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">December 16, 2020, Decree of Necessity and Urgency No. 1,020/2020 (&#8220;Decree 1,020&#8221;) was issued, through which the start of the renegotiation of the RTI concluded in 2018 within the framework of the
          Solidarity Law was determined</span>.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc855" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc856">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc856" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc857">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">According to that decree, the renegotiation period could not exceed <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:TariffReviewPeriod" id="Fact_56eced947a5c4e0faa02c4f5f8884300" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_RangeAxis_TopOfRangeMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear">2</ix:nonNumeric>
        years from the date of entry into force. Until then, the current renegotiation agreements were suspended. Said renegotiation remained in the power of ENARGAS ad-referendum of the PEN. The renegotiation process was to culminate with the signing of a
        Definitive Agreement on the RTI on December 16, 2022. However, on December 7, 2022, Necessity and Urgency Decree No. 815/2022 was published in the BO. (the &#8220;Decree 815&#8221;) which extended the renegotiation period for 12 months from the expected
        expiration of the period provided for in Decree 1020, and said process must now be completed on December 16, 2023. </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc857" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc858">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Additionally, the Solidarity Law provides for the administrative intervention of ENARGAS, recently extended through Decree 1,020, later extended by Decree 815.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc859" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc860">

      </div>

<div style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; margin-left: 18pt;">On March 16, 2021, the
        public hearing convened by ENARGAS was held for the purposes of considering the Transitional Tariff Regime (&#8220;RTT&#8221;) in accordance with the provisions of Decree 1,020. In this regard, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, without renouncing
        the full percentage of tariff recomposition that corresponds to it, alternatively presented at this hearing a proposal for a tariff increase calculated by <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfIncreaseInTariff" id="Fact_4e072d77af094baa892a65dc46ef9752" contextRef="c20210402" unitRef="U004" decimals="3" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">58.6</ix:nonFraction>%,
        as of April 1, 2021. It was calculated based on the financial needs to meet the operating and financial costs, capital investments and taxes, which were calculated considering the evolution of the inflation rate for a period of 12 months from its
        inception. Such requested increase contemplated only the necessary funds to meet the obligations as a licensee.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc861" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc862">
<div><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc862" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc863">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="margin-left: 9pt; text-indent: -9pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">&#160;</div>

<div><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span></div>

        public hearing, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> denied and dismissed the arguments raised in it that considered that the current natural gas transportation tariff is not fair and reasonable given the alleged existence of serious
        defects in the administrative acts derived from the processing of the last Regime Comprehensive Tariff (&#8220;RTI&#8221;) made for <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>.</div>

        ENARGAS sent to <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, a Transitory Agreement Project 2021 within the framework of the provisions of Decree 1,020. Said project provided:</div>

        </span><br/>
        <span style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">On <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">December 16, 2023, decree No. 55/2023 was issued declaring the
              emergency of the national energy sector until December 31, 2024. Among other issues, this decree: (i) establishes the beginning of the process of RTI, (ii) the intervention of ENARGAS as of January 1, 2024 and (iii) instructs the Ministry of
              Energy to issue the necessary standards and procedures for the sanction of market prices for the public transport service of natural gas.</span></span></span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <div style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none; margin-left: 18pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8143" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8144">
<div><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8144" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8145">
<div style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation>
      </div>

</ix:continuation>

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div style="font-weight: bold;">General Framework for non-regulated segments</div>
              </td>

  </tr>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8147" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8148">
<div style="margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8148" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8149">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Domestic market</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8149" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8150">
<div style="margin-left: 36pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8150" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8151">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Production and Commercialization of Liquids and Midstream segments are not subject to regulation by ENARGAS, and as it is provided in the Transfer Agreement, is
        organized as a separate business unit within <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, keeping accounting information separately. However, over recent years, the Argentine Government enacted regulations which significantly impacted on it.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8151" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8152">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8152" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8153">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In April 2005, the Argentine Government enacted Law No. 26,020 which sets forth the regulatory framework for the industry and commercialization of LPG. Among other
        things, the Law No. 26,020 creates the framework through which the Secretary of Hydrocarbon Resources (&#8220;SHR&#8221;) (formerly the Federal Energy Bureau) establishes regulations meant to cause LPG suppliers to guarantee sufficient supply of LPG in the
        domestic market at low prices. Law No. 26,020 creates a price regime pursuant to which the SRH periodically publish reference prices for LPG sold in the domestic market. It also sets forth LPG volumes to be sold in the domestic market.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8153" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8154">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8154" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8155">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">Within this
          framework, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs </span>sells propane and butane production to fractionators at prices determined every six months. </span>On March 30, 2015, the Executive Branch issued Decree No. 470/2015, regulated by
        Resolution No. 49/2015 issued by the Federal Energy Bureau, which created the Programa Hogares con Garrafa (the &#8220;Households with Bottles Program&#8221;) which replaced the programs in force until that time. The Households with Bottles Program was
        implemented through Resolutions No. 49/2015 and No. 470/2015 issued by the Federal Energy Bureau.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8155" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8156">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8156" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8157">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Within the framework of the Households with Bottles Program, a maximum reference price was determined for the members of the commercialization chain in order to
        guarantee the supply to low-income residential users, forcing producers to supply with LPG at a certain price and at a certain quantity defined for each of them. Additionally, the payment of compensation to the participating producers of the
        Households with Bottles Program was established.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8157" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8158">
<div style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8158" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8159">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In this context, the Company has filed several administrative and judicial claims challenging the general regulations of the Home Plan, as well as the administrative
        acts that determine the volumes of butane to be sold in the local market, in order to safeguard its economic-financial situation and so that such situation does not continue in time.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8159" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8160">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
