      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8160" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8161">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Additionally, the Company participates in the Propane Gas Supply Agreement for Indiluted Propane Gas Distribution Networks (&#8220;Propane for Networks Agreement&#8221;) entered
        into with the Argentine Government and propane producing companies whereby it undertakes to supply propane to distributors and sub-distributors of indiluted propane gas through networks at a price lower than the market price, The Company receives
        an economic compensation for the lower revenues derived from the participation in this program, which is calculated as the difference between the agreed sales price and the reference export parity price determined by the Energy Secretariat.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8161" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8162">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8162" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8163">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On August 10, 2021, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> celebrated the eighteenth extension, valid until December 31, 2021. Regarding the agreement valid until
        December 31, 2022, said document was signed on June 23, 2022. During much of 2023 were carried out under the terms of the 2022 agreement in accordance with an instruction from the SE. Finally, on August 18, 2023, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs






        </span>signed, together with the Ministry of Energy and other LPG producers, the twentieth extension of the Propane Agreement for Networks, which was ratified by the PEN through decree 496/2023 on October 2, 2023.<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8163" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8164">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8164" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8165">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">As mentioned above, participation in the Home Plan implies economic-financial losses for the Company, since under certain circumstances the sale of the products would be
        made at prices that are below production costs.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8165" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8166">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8166" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8167">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">As of December 31, 2023, the Argentine State owes <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:CurrentGovernmentGrantsReceivable" id="Fact_e346b6a7612d418ea79b6047d5332b53" contextRef="c20231231" unitRef="U002" decimals="-3" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">4,675,875</ix:nonFraction> for these concepts.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8167" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8168">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8168" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8169">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Foreign market</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8169" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8170">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8170" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8171">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On September 3, 2018, the Executive Branch issued Decree No. 793/2018, which, between September 4, 2018 and December 31, 2020, sets an export duty of <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfExportDuty" id="Fact_746768365dfe466fb0afdeb364366804" contextRef="c20180903_ClassesOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAxis_ButaneMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfExportDuty" id="Fact_3a12ca825fb54945a3b5d4de3487aba1" contextRef="c20180903_ClassesOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAxis_NaturalGasolineMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal"><ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfExportDuty" id="Fact_005ac7e2f45a490e8ac39ba40006bb7d" contextRef="c20180903_ClassesOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAxis_PropaneMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">12</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>% on the exported amount of propane, butane and natural gasoline. This withholding is capped at $<ix:nonFraction name="tgs:AmountOfEachDollarOfTheTaxBaseOrTheOfficialFOBPrice" id="Fact_9001afb70377400a9d0af6e47a5c5094" contextRef="c20180903" unitRef="U006" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">4</ix:nonFraction> for each dollar of the tax base or the official FOB price.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8171" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8172">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8172" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8173">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Subsequently, on the occasion of the enactment of the Solidarity Law, an <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:RateApplicableToHydrocarbons" id="Fact_496ce33b3b77427fa7f3649721834c63" contextRef="c20191223" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">8</ix:nonFraction>%
        cap was established for the rate applicable to hydrocarbons as of December 23, 2019.</div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Presidential Decree No. 488/2020 regulated the applicable tax rate on exports of certain oil and gas products, including those products that we export, establishing a range between <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ApplicableTaxRateOnExportOfOilAndGasProducts" id="Fact_6e104ba7ea3747c380bbcb3748e0ce84" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_RangeAxis_BottomOfRangeMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0</ix:nonFraction>% and <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:ApplicableTaxRateOnExportOfOilAndGasProducts" id="Fact_13b83df010964e0aab53ed0e76585326" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_RangeAxis_TopOfRangeMember" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">8</ix:nonFraction>% depending on the &#8220;ICE Brent
          first line&#8221; barrel price. If the price is below US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:BarrelPriceForApplicableTaxRateConditionOne" id="Fact_a89c7b59d8404be19cdfbd0d71cbdebb" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U014" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">45</ix:nonFraction>, the tax rate will be <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfApplicableTaxRateOnBarrelPriceConditionOne" id="Fact_00f785be37b4419c98630557a444f601" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">zero </ix:nonFraction>percent. On the other hand, if the price is equal to or higher than US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:BarrelPriceForApplicableTaxRateConditionTwo" id="Fact_10990ac1ac3847a5b1cb7238091411fe" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U014" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">60</ix:nonFraction>,
          an <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfApplicableTaxRateOnBarrelPriceConditionTwo" id="Fact_76f55f2afee64ca8b006d0436a61531c" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">8</ix:nonFraction>% tax rate will be paid, being variable if the price is between US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:BarrelPriceForApplicableTaxRateConditionOne" id="Fact_d04c1582a2e441d5990c8ba40c99b677" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U014" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">45</ix:nonFraction> and US$ <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:BarrelPriceForApplicableTaxRateConditionTwo" id="Fact_a0e524362f334187b3e877d6b65bfdc6" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U014" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">60</ix:nonFraction>.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8175" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8176">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8176" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8177">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">During 2023, the Company participated, within the framework of Resolution No. 808/2023 of the Ministry of Energy, of the Export Increase Program created by Decree 576/22.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8177" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8178">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8178" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8179">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">According to said program, the Company must enter <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInForeignCurrency" id="Fact_762ff6f553fb418d979307db7d177d67" contextRef="c20231003to20231003" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">75</ix:nonFraction>% of
        the value of its exports in foreign currency into the country. The remaining <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInPesos" id="Fact_fcb6f8521ae14eebb9ea6a8050dd2c26" contextRef="c20231003to20231003" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">25</ix:nonFraction>% may be settled in pesos through the purchase of
        negotiable securities. To qualify for the scheme, exports must be settled between October 2 and October 20, 2023, and the effective export date must not be later than November 30, 2023.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8179" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8180">

      </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Subsequently, said program was extended by Decree No. 28/2023, which also modifies the settlement ratio, which is currently <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInForeignCurrency" id="Fact_cfd47674083e4b6badd7dae3719d6493" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">80</ix:nonFraction>% through the MULC and the remaining <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:PercentageOfValueOfExportsInPesos" id="Fact_a70a23f16ec24c1da5f0aaaad97e1593" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U004" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">20</ix:nonFraction>% through sales and
        purchase operations of negotiable securities. </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div><span style="font-weight: bold;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8183" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8184">
<div style="font-style: italic; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold;">Decree No. 2,067 / 08 (the &#8220;Decree&#8221;)<br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8184" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8185">
<div style="font-style: italic; margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"> <br/>
        </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8185" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8186">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Through Presidential Decree No. 2,067/08, the Executive Branch created a tariff charge to be paid by: (i) the users of regulated services of transportation and / or
        distribution, (ii) natural gas consumers receiving natural gas directly from producers without making use of transportation systems or natural gas distribution, (iii) the natural gas processing companies in order to finance the import of natural
        gas. The tariff charge sets forth in this decree finance the higher price of the natural gas imports required to compensate the injection of natural gas necessary to meet national requirements (the &#8220;Charge&#8221;). When the Charge was created, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> paid it in accordance with the provisions of Resolution I-563/2008, at Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:TariffChargePaidPerCubicMeter" id="Fact_514d2eecf6d94d5c8a55157be8ef4828" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U015" decimals="4" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0.0492</ix:nonFraction>/m3.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8186" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8187">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8187" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8188">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The payment of the natural gas processing tariff charge was selectively subsidized from 2008 according to the destination of the natural gas. In November 2011, however,
        ENARGAS issued Resolution No. 1,982/11 and 1,991/11 (the &#8220;Subsidy Beneficiaries Resolutions&#8221;) which modified the list of the subsidy beneficiaries, and thus, involved a cost increase for many of our clients and for us (for certain of our
        consumption for our own account). The natural gas processing tariff charge increased from Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:TariffChargePerCubicMeter" id="Fact_fe2f7c9dd2334491a44f231b28ce3b28" contextRef="c20111130to20111130" unitRef="U015" decimals="4" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0.0492</ix:nonFraction> to Ps. <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:TariffChargePerCubicMeter" id="Fact_7db74ec326054e67a9d05e34d547268f" contextRef="c20111201to20111201" unitRef="U015" decimals="3" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">0.405</ix:nonFraction> per cubic meter of natural gas effective from December 1, 2011, representing a significant increase in our variable costs of natural gas
        processing.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8188" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8189">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In order to avoid this damage, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> appealed against the Presidential Decree and the Resolutions including National Government,
        ENARGAS and ex MPFIPyS as defendants.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8190" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8191">

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On March 28, 2016, the former MINEM issued Resolution No. 28/16 (&#8220;Resolution 28&#8221;), which instructs ENARGAS to take all the necessary measures to derogate the tariff
        charge created by Decree No. 2,067/08 as from April 1, 2016. However, such Resolution does not repeal or declare illegitimate this decree and the Subsidy Beneficiaries Resolutions for which the judicial action is still ongoing.</div>

        to the lower of the following two amounts:</div>
</ix:continuation>

        investments carried in US dollars and adjusted by the PPI, net of accumulated depreciation according to the calculation rules to be determined by ENARGAS; or </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8205" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8206">

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Once the period of the extension of the License expires, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> will be entitled to participate in the New Bidding, and thus, it
        shall be entitled to: </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8209" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8210">

        of the business of providing the licensed service as it is driven by the Licensee at the valuation date, as a going concern and without regard to the debts;</div>

</ix:continuation>

<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">(iii) To match the best bid submitted by third parties in the New Bidding, if it would be higher than its bid mentioned in (i), paying the difference between both values
        &#8203;&#8203;to obtain the new License;</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8215" continuedAt="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8216">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7d24f8d56e0f495fb142d55926ee9dc8216">
<div style="margin-left: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> (iv) If the Company is unwilling to match the best bid made by a third party, to receive the appraisal value mentioned in (i) as compensation for the transfer of the
        Essential Assets to the new licensee.</div>
</ix:continuation>
       </div>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">After the issuance of the Resolutions, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> filed a judicial action before the National Court of First Instance in Federal
      Administrative Litigation No. 1 (the &#8220;Court&#8221;) in order to obtain the declaration of nullity of the Presidential Decree No. 2067/08 and the Resolutions as well as the unconstitutionality of the administrative acts that created the Charge.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152711" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152712">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152712" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152713">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On July 5, 2012, the Court issued in favor of <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> a precautionary measure by which the suspension of the Charge was ordered in
      the terms set forth in the Resolutions. This decision was appealed in different opportunities by the National Government, by virtue of which the dictating of the precautionary measure was limited to the validity of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:ValidityPeriodOfPrecautionaryMeasure" id="Fact_96f8249a3e89448b85780087095cb3f6" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">six months</ix:nonNumeric>. However, at maturity, the Company is entitled to obtain a new precautionary measure for a similar period.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152713" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152714">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152714" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152715">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">As a result, on September 19, 2017, a new extension of the injunction was obtained (which prevented the Government to claim <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>
      of the payment of the amounts resulting from the new value of the Charge for the period between the November 2011 and March 2016), thus extending the validity until March 2018.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152715" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152716">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <!--PROfilePageNumberReset%Num%86%F-%%-->
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152716" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152717">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On the other hand, the National Court of Appeals in Contentious Administrative Dismissal rejected the extraordinary appeal filed by the National Government against the
      judgment of that court that confirmed the rejection made by the Court at the request of ENARGAS to declare abstract the legal action initiated by tgs in accordance with the precedent &#8220;Alliance&#8221; issued by the Supreme Court in December 2014.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152717" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152718">

    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152718" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152719">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On March 26, 2019, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> was notified of the judgment of first instance issued by the Federal Contentious-Administrative Court No.
      1 in its claim initiated by which <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> requested the unconstitutionality of Decree No. 2,067/08; Resolutions and of any other rule or act issued or to be issued, that is caused by the mentioned rules (the
      &#8220;Cause&#8221;).</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152719" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152720">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152720" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152721">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The first instance judgment declares the unconstitutionality of both Articles 53 and 54 of Law 26,784, as well as the aforementioned rules and of any other act tending
      to execute said provision, and consequently, the nullity of said rules (the &#8220;sentence&#8221;).</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152721" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152722">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152722" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152723">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The Judgment was appealed by the National Government on March 29, 2019, and the appeal was granted on April 3, 2019, which has not been resolved as of the closing date
      of the year.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152723" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152724">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152724" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152725">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On October 29, 2019, the intervening judge decided, considering what was decided in the judgment and attending to the reasons invoked by <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span>, to extend the validity of the precautionary measure issued for <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:Fact_2b37a8928cae439ba3d74d02d2c055c5">six</span> more months of processing in said ordinary process
      and / or until the sentence passed is firm.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152725" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152726">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152726" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152727">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Pursuant to the isolation measures adopted by the Argentine Government under the COVID development, the judicial deadlines were suspended from March 20, 2020 until July
      21, 2020.<br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152727" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152728">

    </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On December 1, 2020, the court granted a new extension of said injunction for a term of <ix:nonNumeric name="tgs:ExtendedValidityPeriodOfPrecautionaryMeasure" id="Fact_dac4de84528d47c795e052cf983b0880" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" format="ixt-sec:durmonth">6</ix:nonNumeric> months.</div>
</ix:continuation>
    <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152729" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152730">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
    </div>
</ix:continuation>
    <div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152730" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152731">
<div><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">On May 14, 2021, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> was notified of the ruling issued by Chamber I of the Chamber in Contentious-Administrative Matters that (i) has revoked the decision by the
        Judge of First Instance and (ii) has imposed the costs in both instances in the order caused. <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> considers that it has reasonable arguments to defend its position on the substantive issue raised and, for
        that reason, it appealed the judgment of the Chamber.</span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152731" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152732">
<div style="text-align: left; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152732" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152733">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">On June 4, 2021, <span style="font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> filed an extraordinary federal appeal against the judgment of the Chamber, which was contested by ENARGAS
        and the National State, and was granted by the Court of Appeals itself on July 14, 2021, on the understanding that &#8220;At stake is the interpretation and scope of regulations of an unquestionable federal nature, such as Decree 2067/08 and MINPLAN
        Resolution No. 1451/2008, ENARGAS Resolutions No. 1982/11 and 1991/11, as well as articles 53 and 54 of Law 26,784&#8221;.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152733" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152734">
<div style="text-align: left; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152734" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152735">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">By virtue of the precautionary measure issued, and its <ix:nonFraction name="tgs:NumberOfExtensionsObtained" id="Fact_e0bf09a727a546d1b39ffd584b204863" contextRef="c20210604to20210604" unitRef="U005" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">12</ix:nonFraction>
        extensions obtained, as well as the favorable judgment obtained in the first instance, the existence of favorable precedents issued by the Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation (&#8220;Supreme Court&#8221;) with respect to other processors of natural gas and
        the granting of the extraordinary appeal that will give rise to the Supreme Court ruling on the case, the management of <span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-weight: bold;">tgs</span> and its legal advisors consider
        that they have solid arguments to defend their position and that it is probable that a favorable resolution will be obtained for their interests on the substantive issue raised. Therefore, no provision has been made for the eventual liabilitie due
        to the increase in the charge to finance the importation of natural gas applicable to natural gas consumption related to the processing activity at the Cerri Complex for the period between the date of obtaining the measure precautionary and on
        April 1, 2016, date of entry into force of Resolution No. 28/2016.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152735" continuedAt="Text_7be1da0b039e4b8ebd20209632cb152736">
